tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ theg chen shing rta'i srol gnyis las ji ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems skyed 'bogs chog thar pa'i gru gzings bzhugs so/ 2)na ma sarba bud+dha bo dhi satā bh+yaḥ gang gi thugs bskyed smon lam mthu yis khams gsum 'gro ba ma lus rnams/ srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las skyobs cing bla na med pa'i byang chub cher/ 'god mdzad ston pa thugs rje'i bdag dang de sras par bzhugs 'phags mchog tshogs/ bdag dang mtha' yas pha mar gyur kun phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi/ lam dman lam log lam gol gyi/ nyo zho 3)las bzlog yang dag lam/ rgyal rnams bgrod pa gcig pa'i mchog byang sems rin chen bskyed byed bshad/ phyogs bcu dus bzhir byon bzhugs rgyal ba kun/ rin chen byang chub sems kyi lam bzang la/ brten nas go 'phang mchog rab brnyes mdzad na/ thar 'dod skal bzang 'di la nyer brtson rigs/ gang zhig skal ba dang bsod nams kyis mngon par mtho ba theg chen gyi rigs nges pa'i dad ldan byang chub kyi mchog tu sems 4)bskyed pa don du gnyer bdag 'ongs pa gyur pa na/ de dag bla med byang chub kyi las la dkri ba'i phyir theg pa chen po'i rnam 'dren du 'os pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen des/ gnas khang gtsang dkon mchog gi rten ji tsam 'dzom zhing bzang ba dang*/ mthar yang bcom ldan 'das la nye ba'i sras kyis bskor ba'i bris sku tsam ni med mi rung zhing*/ de'i spyan sngar mchod pa'i yo byad kyang bzang zhing rgyas par gshams te/ de ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che skye ba'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel yin phyir/ sngon jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la bod ston mang pos sems bskyed 5)mnyes par/ mchod pa ngan pa 'di 'dras byang sems rgyud la mi skye gsungs te/ lan gsum gyi bar du mchod pa dpangs bstod dgos pa byung ba'i lo rgyus bzhin/ mchod rdzas bzang zhing bkod pa'i khyad par phun sum tshogs par bya/

byang sdom gyi cho ga'i phyag bzhes la lar 'di skabs su bar chad zhi zhing tshogs rdzogs phyir gtor ma yang ci 'byor bsham dang 'bul ba'i tshul gsung pa yod mod kyi/ de ltar bya bar spro na'ang de ka'i lugs bzhin byar rung mod kyang*/ 'dir ni shing rta'i srol gnyis ka mdo lugs yin phyir gtor ma med pa'i lugs ltar byas pa yin zhing*/ gang ltar yang*/ slob dpon du 'os pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de nyid chos kyi khri stan bzang po 6)la 'khod pa'i drung na/ sems bskyed par 'dod pa'i slob ma rnams gus phyag dgung brugs sngon du btang la dngos po dag pa'i me tog dang byang chub la nye bar dmigs pa'i dad pa dang bcas pa'i mdun du sus btsug thal sbyar gyis 'dug pa la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog dpe 'jam zhing brda 'phrod pa'i ngag gis 'di skad 'doms par bya'o/ ༈ e ma/ skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu dang bu mo rnams/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed par 'dod pa ni shin tu yang ngo mtshar gyi mchog dang rab dang phul du gyur pa nyid yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na gnas skabs su 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde legs kyi yon tan mtha' dag byang chub kyi 7) sems rin po che las 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa yang 'di kho nas la rag las pa'i phyir na/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i nus pa dang phan yon las byung ba ste/ ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang ldan zhing stong khams kha lo bsgyur nus pa dang*/ lha'i rgyal po tshangs pa brgya byin/ klu'i dbang po 'jig rten bde bar skyong ba thams cad dang*/ mi'i nang na rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba dag dang*/ bram ze'i rigs shing pā la chen po lta bu dang*/

khyim bdag bsod nams dang 8)'byor pas mngon par mtho ba thams cad byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i phan yon las byung ba 'ba' zhig yin pa dang*/ gzhan yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ bdud rtsi'i chu/ rin po che'i gter khungs/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog nad sel ba'i sman mchog la sogs 'jig rten gyi dpal yon ji snyed pa yang rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi byang chub kyis sems mchog bskyed pa'i mthu byin las byung ba yin te/ rgyal yum sher phyin gyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten na yod na lha dang mi'i 'jig rten yod do/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba dang*/ bram ze dang khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten na yod do/ gser dang dngul dang 9)baiḍūr+ya la sogs pa rin po che thams cad 'jig rten na yod do/ ces gsung pa bzhin dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' gcig kho na bzhugs pa'iyul khams gang na ba der nad ngang mtshon dang mu ge sogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung zhing*/ 'byung po sha za mi ma yin gyi 'tshe ba yang mi 'byung ba nyid de/ 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su skye ba bzhes nas bzhugs pa'i yul khams su gnod sbyin sha za spun lngas 'tsho bar ma nus pa'i skyes rabs rnam thar lta bu'i yon tan 'byung ba lags pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa nges par legs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyu dang sa bon ni 'di kho na las gzhan pa gang gis 10)kyang mi 'grub ste/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba bdag gzhan kun chu shing po bzhin/ 'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur mod kyi/ byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*/ 'bras bu 'byin pa mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ zhes sogs dang*/ sdong po bkod par yang*/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad bskyed pa'i sa bon lta bu'o/ zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs phyir/ khyed cag la 'di lta bu bskyed par 'dod pa'i blo yod pa yang sngon gyi tshe rabs mang po nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin la/

de ltar ma yin na byang chub kyi sgra dang ming tsam thos par yang shin ru dka' bar gsungs nas/ khyed rnams 11)bsod nams kyi mthu dang skal ba bzang bar gdon mi za ba nyi dang*/ byang chub kyi sems de yang rgyu med pa las mi skye bas na rgyu tshogs tshang dgos te/ rgyu ni bka' bstan bcos rnams las gsungs tshul du ma mchis te/ de yang 'phags pa chos bcu pa'i mdo nas rgyu bzhir gsungs pa ste/ sems bskyed pa'i phan yon mthong ba dang*/ dkon mchog la dad pa dang*/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal mthong bas snying rje bskyed pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par bskul ba dang bzhir gsungs/ mgon po byams pas ni/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ dge ba'i bshes kyis zin pa/ sems can la snying brtse ba/ gzhan don 12)spyod pa na 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sogs kyi dka' ba bzod pa dang bzhir yang gsung pa/ slob dpon chen po zhi lhas ni/ rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyi mthus byang chub kyi rigs sad pa dang*/ dad pa dang snying rje'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa la bzhed/ slob dpon thog med kyis ni byang chub sems dpa'i sar bshad pa bzhin/ byang chub kyi rigs su nges pa dge ba'i bshes kyis zin pa/ snying rje che ba/ sdug bsngal gyi dka' bas mi 'jigs pa ste rgyu bzhi dang*/ bde gshegs kyi yon tan la mos pa/ theg chen gyi chos thos pa/ dam pa'i chos nus par nye bar mthong ba/ sems can gyi nyon mongs pas mthong ba ste rkyen bzhi dang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi bsam pa dang rgyu dang sbyor ba'i stobs dang bzhi ste 13)bcu gnyis la bzhed/ jo bo chen po ni/ rigs kyi nus pa sad pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten cing de la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher bsags pa snying rje tshad med dang ldan pa/ dad pa khyad par can gyi stobs dang ldan pa/ theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa dang ldan pa ste/

de ltar rgyu drug tshang dgos par bzhed cing*/ de thams cad nye bar bsdus na/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad pa/ khams gsum sems can la snying rje/ byang chub sgrub nus pa'i shes rab dang gsum po tshang dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyu de dag phal cher khyed cag la tshang bar gzhi grub la/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis byas 14)nas sems bskyed thob dgos pa yang bdag gis bgyis pas tshang bar rung lags/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che de nyid bskyed pa'i thabs la mod don rnams pa drug gi sgo nas ston pa yin te/ gang zhai na/ gang gis blang ba'i rten gyi gang zag gang las bla ba'i yul gyi khyad par/ gang blang ba'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ ji ltar len pa'i cho ga'i rim pa/ blangs pa de mi nyams par bsrung zhing spyod thabs/ de ltar thob cing bsgrubs pa'i yon tan bstan pa dang drug gi sgo ston par bgyid do/ de las dang por/ sems bskyed pa'i rten gyi gang zag la thun mong dang khyad par gnyis las/ thun mong ni gong du brjod pa'i rgyu'i mtshan nyid ci rigs tshang ba dang*/ khyad par gyi rten la de yang byang 15)sems kyi ngo bo la khyad med rung rnam pa ltar na/ 'phags yul zab mo lta ba'i rgyud pa dang*/ rgya chen spyod pa'i rgyud pa ces/ rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul gyi shing rta'i srol chen gnyis su grags pa'i/ 'jam dbyangs klu sgrub dang byams mgon thog med gnyis kyi bzhed gzhung las byung ba'i khyad par la/ deng sang bod 'dir sems bskyed la yang dbu la lugs dang sems tsam lugs zhes tha dad du 'bod pa'i srol dar mod kyang*/ lta ba dbu sems tha dad du grags pa las/ sems bskyed la dbu sems so sor yod par bka' bstan bcos khungs ma dag las kyang mi 'byung yang*/ rgyud pa'i bka' srol gnyis pa la phyag bzhes rgyas bsdus cung zad mi 'dra bas dbu sems bskyed du ming thogs pa

16)lags shing*/ des na 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs nas/ klu sgrub dang zhi ba lha sogs thab mo lta rgyud kyi bzhed gzhung las ni lha klu sogs med ma yin dang*/ mi'i 'gro ba brda shes don go ba dad dang snyig rjer lhan na lus rten gang lta bu la yang byang chub sems kyi rten dang snod du rung bar bzhed de/ sngon ston pa nid zhal bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sems bskyed pa'i lha klu mi'i byang sems grangs med mchis mod la/ yang*/ de dag sangs rgyas kyi mthu byin yin gyi/ gzhan gyis de ltar mi nus sam snyam na/ rgya bod kyi skyes chen mang pos ma yin pa'i 'gro ba du ma la sems bskyod gnang tshul gyi lo rgyus mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba gang yin pa de dag la byang chub sems bskyed kyang nges par skye bar 17)bzhed cing*/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga yang spros pa nyer bsdus kyi sgo nas mdzad/ ༈ 'phags pa byams mgon nas thogs med sku mched sogs rgya chen spyod rgyud pa'i bzhed srol la ni lha dang sgra mi snyan pa sogs la nges 'byung dang thar pa 'dod pa'i lhag bsam med pas na/ sems bskyed kyi rten ni gling gsum gyi dal 'byor tshang ba dang dang*/ de la yang po thar ris bdun gang rung gi sdom ldan dgos par bzhed cing*/ de dang mthun par jo bos kyang byang chub lam sgron du de ltar gsungs pa ni/ de dus bod yul 'dir mdo sngags gang dang mi mthun pa'i spyod rtsings pa mang pos bstan pa la rma 'byin pa de dag la dgongs pa'i dgos pa khyad par can la gzigs shing bstan pa'i zhabs 18)'debs la dgongs par gsal te/ mdor na rgya chen spyod rgyud pa'i phyag bzhed la sems bskyed kyi che ga'i las rim yang rgyas par mdzad pa dang*/ de ltar shing rta'i srol lugs gnyis po gang las thob kyang gang zag de'i rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskrun pa la khyad par ma mchis mod kyi/

sdom rten gyi bzhed tshul sogs kyi khyad par la dpag nas/ sems bskyed zhu ba'i gang zag khyim pa pho mo sogs lta bu la zab mo rgyud kyi lugs dang*/ gang zag so thar gyi sdom ldan dag gis ni rgya chen spyod rgyud ltar gyi sems bskyed len pa skabs su babs pa lags/ ༈ gnyis pa gang las blang ba'i yul gyi khyad par ni/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/ bla ma sdom pa la gnas shing*/ nus dang ldan las blang bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa 19)bzhin la/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid kyang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas ni/ theg chen don la mkhas shing*/ byang sems kyi sdom pa srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ba zhig la bzhed/ 'phags pa thog med ni/ chos dang mthun pa/ byang sdom dang ldan pa/ theg chen la mkhas pa/ ngag gi rnam par rig byed kyi don 'dzin cig go bar byed nus pa/ ma dad pa med pa/ snying rje dang ldan pa ste/ mtshan nyid drug ldan la bzhed/ jo bo chen po ni/ theg chen gyi don dang bslab pa'i gnas mtha' dag ston pa la mkhas pa/ rang nyid byang sems kyi sdom pa thob la ma nyams par/ slob ma la sdom pa 'bogs par byed pa la skyo dub med kyang dka' ba bzod pa/ zang zing sogs la mi lta ba'i snying rjes slob ma 20)rjes su 'dzin nus pa ste/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan dgos par gsungs te/ bzhed tshul de thams cad don gyi dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab phyir/ yon tan de dag dang ldan pa las blangs bar bya la/ gal te bshes gnyen de lta bu ma bzhugs pa'am/ bzhugs kyang de'i spyan sngar 'gro ba ma lus srog dang tshangs spyod sogs la bar chad du 'gyur ba'i 'jigs pa dang bcas pa zhig yin na/ dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du mchod pa'i yo byad bzang po dang bcas pas rang nyid kyis blang du rung zhing*/ gsal te yul mtha' 'khob kyi dbang du gyur pa lta bus dkon mchog gi rten dag kyang ma 'dzoms par gyur na ni mdun gyi nam mkhar dkon mchog bskyed pa las kyang bla bar gsung mod kyi/

brnyed cing 'dzom na ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen kho na las len par 21)bya ste/ des spang blang gi gnas mtha' dag ston cing lung 'bogs par byed pa dang*/ the tshom gyi gnas sel zhing sdom pa'i dpang po dang ngo tsha khrel yod kyi rten du 'gyur ba sogs dgos pa du ma dang ldan pa lags/ ༈ gsum pa gang blang ba'i byang ba'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bo de ji lta bu zhig yin snyam na/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ ces gsungs pa ltar nam mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par 'dod pa'i bsam pa rgya che ba zhig yin la/ de ltar byed pa la rang nyid skyon ma dag yon tan ma rdzogs/ nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba brgya phrag gis bcings 22)bzhin pa 'di lta bus na mkha' mnyam du ma zad sems can gcig tsam yang byang chub la 'god pa'i nus stobs ma mchis mod kyi/ de lta bu'i nus pa ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig las gzhan gag la yang mi mnga' bas na sangs rgyas thob dgos la/ gang zhig 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang rang nyid 'ba' zhig 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la skrag cing de las thar ba'i byang chub kyi rgyu la bzhugs nas 'bad pas sgrubs pa ni sems bskyed spyi'i don yin la/ de'i bye brag tu gang zag blo chung 'bring ched ba'i khyad par gyis/ rang nyid sngon la byang chub kyi go 'phang grub nas 23)'gro ba gzhan sgrol ba rgyal po'am ded dpon lta bu'i sems bskyed/ rang dang sems can lhan cig tu thar bar 'dod pa gnyan pa lta bu'i sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad byang chub las ma 'khod kyi bar du rang nyid thar ba'i 'dod pa mi byed pa rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed sogs kyi rnams grangs kyang yod la/ gzhan yang sems bskyed kyi dbye ba la/ rang gi ngo bos dbye na kun rdzob byang sems dang don ma byang sems/

rgyud la skye tshul gyis dbye na brda las thos pa dang chos nyid kyis thos pa gnyis/ gang zag gi sa mtshams kyi dbye na/ las dang po sa nas mos spyod kyi sa la gnas ring ni mos pas thob pa las byung ba'i 24)sems skyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du lhag bsam dag pa'i sems skyed/ dag pa gsum la rnam par smin pa'i sems skyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sar sgrib pa spangs ba'i sems skyed sogs khyad par gyi dbye ba dang*/ sdong po bkod pa'i mod sogs nas dpe dang grogs kyis phyes pas nyer gnyis dang brgyad cu sogs kyi dbyed ba phra zhib mtha' yas pa gsungs na'ang*/ don gyi snying po ni gzhan don du sangs rgyas sgrub pa nyid la 'du ba lags/ ༈ de las da ltar lag len du gdab par bya rgyu'i dngos don smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis brda dang cho ga las thob pa dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems ni chos nyid kyi thob cing sgom stobs kyi skye bar bzhed pa yin la/ ༈ smon 'jug gnyis 25)po'i mtshan nyid la/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas ni/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba gnyis kyi dpe don spyod 'jug tu gsungs shing*/ bslab btus su/ spyod pa dang mi ldan pa ni smon pa dang spyod pa dang ldan pa ni 'jug par bzhed/ slob dpon thogs med ni/ byang chub la smon cing de 'dod pa ste 'bras bu la dmigs pa ni smon pa dang*/ byang chub kyi spyod la zhugs te lam la dmigs pa ni 'jug pa byang sems su gsungs pa dang*/ de dang mthun par jo bos kyang*/ smon pa byang sems ni 'bras bu la dam 'cha' ba dang*/ 'jug pa ni rgyu la dam 'cha' ba yin zhes gsungs/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las/ sdom pas ma bsdus pa smon pa dang sdom pas bsdus pa ni 'jug par 26)gsung pa sogs/ tshig gi brjod tshul sna tshogs kyang don gyi dgongs bzhed la khyad par ma mchis pa nyid lags shing*/ nges chig dang 'brel pa khyed cag gis go bde ba'i phal skad lta bu'i dbang du bgyis na/

ci'i phyir smon pa dang 'jug pa'i ming du btags ce na/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mthong ba la dad pad dang ba skyes nas/ bdag dang sems can rnams kyang de lta bu thob na ci ma rung*/ thob par shog cig snyam pa'i smon 'dun drag po skyes pa de la smon pa byang sems zhes bya ste/ dper na/ 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di nyid rdza mkhan yangs pa'i mig ces bya bar skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe bde gshegs shāka thub chen po grong khyer la bsod snyoms su byon pa dang mjal ma thag dang ba khyad par can skyes te 27)rang nyid dal 'byor pa dman pas/ rtswa las byas pa'i gdugs cig dang*/ rdza'i bum pa/ mchil lham zung*/ kar+sha sā ṇa lnga dang bcas pa phul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*/ zhes sogs kyis smon pa byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa la brten nas/ ston pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas pa'i tshe mtshan dpe'i sku dang 'khor 'dus pa dang sku tshe sogs shākya thub chen po de ci 'dra bar gyur ba lta bu lags/ de bzhin du/ 'jug pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ba yang ji ltar smon pa'i don de nyid yid smon tsam la mi 'jog par de sgrub par byed pa la g.yol ba med pa'i brtson pa dang skyo ngal med pa'i spro ba dang dka' ba bzod pa'i snying stobs sogs kyis 'bad pa mthar son pa la 28)pa'i phyir/ 'jug pa'i ming gis brjod pa ste/ de lta bu yang 'o skol gyi stob pa byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu+u 'khyud ces bya ba'i mdun na 'don bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du skye ba zhes pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang bcas pa lo khri phrag mang po'i bar du mchod pa'i yo byad mtha' yas pas mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i mthar/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams rgyal po nyid ni 'jig rten gyi mngon par mtho ba'i rgyur bsngo bar 'dod pa la/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkus bskul zhing bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis nges legs byang chub kyi rgyu kho nar nan gyis bsngor bcug cing*/ de tshe sangs rgyas kyis mthus 29)phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' dag rgyal blon btsun mo 'khor bcas kyis sgrib med du mthong bar byin gyis brlabs te rang rang mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing khams gang la mos par byang chub pa'i smon lam 'debs su bcug pa na/ rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu 'khyud ni pad+mo bde ba can gyi zhing khams su 'tshang rgyas te mkha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren par sems bskyed cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pas kyang*/ rgyal po chen po khyed deng 'dir bdag cag rnams lo grangs 'di snyed du mchod cing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i mthus/ ma 'ong pa na bde ba can gyi zhing du rgyal po khyod nyid sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ zhes lung bstan pa bzhin du gyur ba dang*/ sras dang btsun mo blon 'bangs gzhan thams cad kyis 30)kyang rang rang gang la mos pa'i zhing khams de dang der 'tshang rgya bar smon lam btab pa dang mthun par de bzhin gshegs pas kyang lung ston par mdzad par gyur kyang*/ 'o skol mi mjed kyi zhing 'di ni zhing khams gzhan gang las kyang ngan zhing yid du mi 'ong ba/ ngam grog dang gcong rong g.yang sa dang rdo seg dang tsher ma sogs kyis btams pas mi bde ba/ sman shing lo 'bras me tog sogs nyung zhing mthu zhan pa/ mi rnams kyang tshe dang gzugs stobs longs spyod dman la nyon mongs pa'i rba glong rab tu 'khrug pas 'dul bar dka' ba'i zhing 'di ba bdag gir mdzad pa dang 'dul spro ba su yang ma byung ba na/ mdun na 'don rgya mtsho'i rdul de nid snying rje dang brtson 'grus dang bzod stobs sogs gzhan las rmad du byung ba'i mthus/ mi mjed kyi 31)zhing khams 'di 'dul ba'i skyabs mgon du dam bcas pa la de bzhin gshegs pa rin che snying pos kyang bram ze chen ཿpo legs po legs so/

khyod ma 'ong pa'i dus na mi mjed kyi zhing der de bzhin gshegs pa shākya'i dbang sar sangs rgyas nas rgyal ba gzhan gyis dor ba'i rmu rgod kyi gdul bya rnams tshad med pa'i thugs rjes 'dul bar gyur gyi/ de lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi dam bca' zung zhig ces bsngags shing lung bstan pa ltar/ bram zes kyang gzhan las khyad par du byung ba'i smon lam chen po lnga brgya btabs shing 'jug pa byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa'i mthus/ 'o skol gyi ston pa 'di sangs rgyas gzhan las lhag pa'i thugs rje dang 'phrin las mchog tu gyur pa lags te 32)'jug pa byang chub kyi sems zhes pa'i phan yon dang sgra don de lta bu mchis pa yang thugs la nges 'tshal zhing*/ de ltar 'di yan chad rnams ni skal ba bzang po dang lhan pa khyed cag rnams byang chub la blo nges pa'i rgyu rkyen du 'gyur phyir zab mo'i gtam che tsam zhig snyan du gsol ba lags/ ༈ bzhi pa byang chub kyi sems de nyid ji ltar blang ba'i cho ga dngos la/ shing rtī gsol gnis po gang las blang yang chog pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i chu bo gnyis gcig tu bsdoms nas 'bogs par mdzad pa'i phyag bzhed kyang yod mod kyi/ 'on kyang ding sang grub mtha' chos rgyud phal mo tshe rnams srol gnyis po tha dad du mdzad pa'i mang zhing*/ sdom rten gyi kyed par sogs 'bye bde bar snang ba dang bcas pas/ 'di yang 33)sbyor rjes mthun pa'i skabs rnams gcig dril dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga lugs so so las ji ltar byung ba bzhin bston pa la/ ༈ thog mar sbyor ba'i cho ga la gsum ste/ srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' spong zhing yang dag byang chub don du gnyer bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad bsrung zhing dkon mchog gsum la gus pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi rgyu tshogs nye bar sgrub phyir yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba dang gsum las/

dang po ni/ 'o skol rnams dal 'byor gyi mi lus tsam thob kyang nam 'chi cha med kyi chos can te/ skyes zin pa nas nam yang 'chi ba la rdog sna 34)gtad zin pa kho na dang*/ 'chi ba gcig pu tsam du ma zad de khams sum 'khor ba zo chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin skye 'chi'i 'khrul 'khor gyi rgyun la chod pa'i dus ni med/ gang dang gang du skyes kyang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin ni sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las bde ba'i go skabs skra rtse'i khyon tsam yang med do/ ngan song gsum du skyes na ni sdug bsngal te bzod pa'i blags med/ mtho rus su skyes pa rnams kyang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi grabs su chud chud pa/ khams gong ma'i lhar skyes na ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sa bon du thebs thebs pa'i chos nyid yin phyir nam du'ang khams gsum mtha' dag bsdul gyi rgyu dang gnas dang rten dang 'byung khungs las ma 'das pa na/ de ltar mi rig par sdug bsngal ba la bde bar 'khrul/ mi rtag pa la 35)rtag par re/ mi bden pa la bden par 'dzin te/ da du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sgrub ma thub kyi dgos pa lta bus rang phu yang gis bsgrub pa 'di khams gsum sems can kun gyi mtshan nyid du gda' ba 'di la zhen chags kyi bla gtan nas spong ba gsal che lalalalalaste/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdor/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthong ba na/ skyo ba'i sems ni rab tu bskyed/ khams gsum brtson rar 'jigs pa dang*/ brtson pa'i sems ni spong bar bya/ zhes pa bzhin 'bad dgos pa dang*/ yang*/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal lar thar rung zhi ba myang 'das phyogs gcig par zhen du mi rung ste/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal mthong ba la skyo ste rang nyid 'ba' shig thar ba tsam zhig don du 36)gnyer bas ni nya rang gi byang chub 'grub kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang la mi nye ste/ slob dpon ār+ya de was/ bsam gtan nags mes yang dang yang du ni/ nyon mongs tshang tshing bsregs par gyur na yang*/

bdag lta'i rtsa ba brtan po ma spongs pas/ char gyis brlan bzhin mod la rab tu skye/ zhes pa bzhin 'gyur ba dang*/ khyad par du nam mkha' gar khyab kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag pa rnams bdag nyid kyi pha ma drin can ma byas pa ni su yang med/ de yang lan grangs gcig tsam 'ga' tsam byas pa lta bu ma yin te/ 'khor ba thog med nas da lta yan chad du rgyud ma chad par byas pa'i byas pa'i grangs ni mtha' yas pa 'di dag byang chub kyi go 'phang 37)mchog la 'god pa las gzhan pa thabs gang gis kyang drin lan 'khor mi nus shing*/ 'dor du yang rung ba ma yin te/ slob springs las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i khongs su chud gyur pa/ glong gi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/ skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med/ ces gsungs pa bzhin/ grangs cing mtha' yas pa'i pha ma sems can 'di dag bdag cag gis 'dren pa'i gnyer babs pa lags shing*/ de ltar bya ba la rang nyid srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das dam pa thob dgos la/ de thob pa'i rgyu dang thabs kyi gtso bo ni byang chub 38)kyi sems rin po che 'di kha na yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas ni snying rje'i rtsa ba can byang chub sems kyi rgyu las byung ba/ thabs kyi mthar phyin par byas pa'o/ zhes pa nyid 'bad pas bsgrub dgos phyir de lta bu'i bsam pa khyad par can dang ldan par mdzad nas byang chub kyi sems de nyid khyod kyi rgyud la ma thob pa thob par bya ba dang*/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba dang*/ ma smin pa smin par bya ba'i phyir slob dpon la gsol ba gdab dgos te bdag po'i rkyen ni 'di la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ ji skad du/ sdong pa'i bkod pa'i mdor/ nor bzang la 'jam dpal gyi bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i thabs yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen

39)las gdon mi za bar rtogs par gyis shig ces sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ de ltar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen la tha mal pa'i 'du shes kyis ni byang chub kyi sems rgyud la mi skye bas na/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed dgos par ni/ ji skad du/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ 'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas/ ces sogs dang*/ gang la mos pa'i yid byed pa/ de hayi mdun na thub pa bzhugs/ ces pa ltar yin pas na bdag slob dpon la ston pa sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam du mos pa thun mong ma yin pa mdzad nas/ khyed cag rang rang so so'i lus longs spyod gtan 'dun thams cad mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du 'bul ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas pas/ phyag thal mo 40)sbyar ba'i bar du me tog sim ma thogs nas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshig 'di rjes bzlos su mdzad par zhu/ ༈ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di rang rang gi ming brjod de zhes bgyi ba yang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba gdab pa lan gsum pa'i mthar phyag tu bsnams pa'i me tog sil ma rnams slob dpon gyi phyogs su 'thor bar mdzad do/ sngon 'o skol gyi ston pa 41)nyid bram ze'i khyi'u sprin du skye ba bzhes tshe rgyal mchog mar me mdzad kyi spyan sngar byang chub macog tu thugs bskyed pa na/ me tog ut+pa la lnga zhig dad pa'i sems kyis gtor ba las ut+pa la dpag tu med par gyur pa rnams rgyal ba'i dbu'i steng du ut+pa la'i khang rtsegs chen por gyur te/ bram ze'i bsod nams kyi tshogs mngon par 'phel zhing byang chub tu lung ston pa de bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad par zhu/

༈ gnyis pa byang chub la bar du gcod pa bsrung zhing skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ de yang spyid bar du gcod pa po ni mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bdud kyi bye brag la btags mod kyang*/ skabs 'dir ni mkha' mnyam gyi 'gro ba thams cad pha ma'i rang bzhin du gyur bdud dang bdud kyi bar chad 42)dadu 'dzin rgyu'i dngos pos dben la/ srung ba thams cad kyi nang nas byang chub sems kyi go cha ni srung ba'i mchog yin phyir gzhan la dgos la/ 'on kyang byang chub las phyir ldog pa'i blo ma rungs pa skyes na byang chub kyi gegs su byed pas/ de bsrung ba la byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid ched du mngags pa ni de nyid kyi smon lam gyi mthu yin phyir/ des na 'o skol rnams gnas pa'i snang yul 'di thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku nam mkha'i khams khyab pa gcig gi nang khongs su chud par bsam pa mdzad 'tshal te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la brten pa ni tha na ba bu'i khungs bu gcig la brten pa yang bdud dang bdud kyi rigs su gtogs pa bye ba dung phyur gyis kyang g.yo bar 43)mi nus so/ zhes thugs rje chen po pad ma cod paṇa gyi rgyud dang pun+dha rī ka'i mdo sogs las gsungs pas na srung 'khor gyi mchog tu gyur pa lags/ ༈ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba la spyi dang khyad par gnyis las/ spyir ni phyi pa mu stegs pa dang nang pa sangs rgyas pa gnyis po skyabs 'gro kho nas kyang byang chub kyi lam du 'gro mi 'gro'i khyad par gyur pa dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa la'ang theg pa gsum ga skyabs 'gro la brten dgos par ni mgon po byams pas rgyud bla mar/ ston pa bstan pa slob dpon gyi/ theg pa gsum dang byed pa gsum/ mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ bstan pa dam chos 44)slob ma dge 'dun te/

dkon mchog gsum la mos pas skyabs gnas su byed pa ni nyan rang byang sems kyi theg pa gsum po spyir mthun yang*/ bye brag tu theg pa che chung la skyabs 'gro'i yul dang dus dang bsam pa'i khyad par tha dad pa ste theg dman pa gnyis po yul ni sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa sku/ chos thun mong gi lung rtogs/ dge 'dun nyan rang gi dgra bcom pa rnams la 'dod kyang*/ theg chen du de thams cad 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid can te/ gtan gyi skyabs gnas ma yin pa dang bsam pa yang nyan rang gnyis po rang nyid zhi ba don gnyer dang*/ dus kyang ji srid 'tsho bar las med tshe byang chub kyi rgyu dang sems can gyi don ma yin pas 'dir mi bzhed la theg pa chen po 'di ni bla med byang chub tu 'gro kun sgrol ba'i shing rta 45)chen po yin phyir/ sher phyin sdud pa las kyang*/ de gang zhon nas sems can thams cad mya ngan zlo/ theg pa 'di ni mkha' 'dra gzhal med khang chen te/ dga' skyid bde ba mngon par thob byed theg pa'i mchog ces gsungs pa nyid yin pas na skyabs 'gro yang thun mong ma yin pa khyad par can gyi don dang ldan pa lags te/ de yang*/ yul ni sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ chos theg chen gyi lung rtogs/ dge 'dun pa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang sems 'phags tshogs rnams la/ dus byang chub snying po'i bar du bsam pa mkha' khyab kyi sems can yod do cog sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god phyir du skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ de lta bu'i khyad don rnams khyed cag so so'i 46)thugs la nges par mdzad nas/ 'o skol gyi mdun 'dir sku gsung thugs rten dngos su bshams pa 'di dag mtshon byed du bgyis nas/ nam mkha'i khams 'dir pad+ma nyid zla'i gdan yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng na khyad par lgayi skyabs yul theg chen gyi dkon mchog ma lus pa sprin phung 'khrig pa ltar khra lam me mngon sum du bzhugs par mos pa dang*/

bdag slob dpon la yang tha mal pa'i snang ba ma mdzad par/ sku byang sems kyi dge 'dun/ gsung theg chen gyi dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i ngo bor mos pa'i ngang nas/ rang gzhan mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad thams cad bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob phyir kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas skyabs su mchi'o/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 47)thugs rjes bzung zhig snyam pa'i dad gus kyi gdungs bags bskyed de thal mo sbyar nas skyabs 'gro'i tshig 'di dag gi rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa don dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su 48)mchi'o/

zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog thor du bzhug go ༈ de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa 'di lta bu blangs shing thob pa'i phan yon dpag tu med do/ de thams cad jo bos don brgyad du bsdus nas gsungs pa rnams go bde ba'i phyir brjod na/ dkon mchog gsum skyabs su song ba tsam gyis nang pa sangs rgyas pa khyur chud pas dkon mchog gis thugs rjes zin pa dang*/ bslab sdom mtha' dag gi gzhi rten du 'gyur ba dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod 'tshe mtha' dag las skyobs cing bsrung ba dang*/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zad par byed pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher 'phel ba dang*/ tshe 'phos pa na ngan song log par ltung bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ lam gyi yon tan khyad par can rgyud la skye ba dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tshang rgya 49)bar 'gyur ba ste/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can gyi phan yon ni de lta bu 'byung ba lags/ ༈ de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i sdom pa thob nas/ de'i bslab bya dang bsrung bya'i gnas rnams la slob dgos te/ de ma mchog gsum so so'i bslab bya drug dang*/ thun mong gi lnga yod pa rnams thugs rgyud la nges par byas nas spang blang tshul bzhin sgrub 'tshal te/ de dag gang zhe na/ de yang sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas ni 'jig rten gsum na do las lhag pa'i skyabs gnas gang yang ma mchos pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi lha tshangs pa brgya byin phyā dang dbang phyug sogs nas/ rang rang gi pho lha dgra lha yul lha sogs gang la yang skyabs gnas mi re/ chos la skyabs su song nas dam pa'i chos ni thog mtha' bar su 50)dge ba'i rang bzhin yin pas de las skyabs su byas nas ni sems can la gnod 'tshe byed na sdig pa chen po cher 'gyur bas gtan nas spang*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas grogs chad pa mtshungs par spyod pa'am/ lta ba mthun pa/ spyod pa mthun pa/

skyabs gnas mthun pa dang 'grogs dgos kyi/ dkon mchog la skyabs su mi 'dzin pa/ lta ba log pa sgyu 'bras la mi brtsi ba sdig pa spyod pa'i grogs la bsten par mi bya'o/ de ltar dgag pa'i bslab bya gsum bstan nas/ gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i bslab bya ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song phyin chad nas bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mchod rten gyi rigs bris 'bur che chung legs mi legs ci lta bu zhig snang yang phyag mchod bkur bsti 51)zhabs gtogs su gang 'gyar la 'bad pa ma gtogs/ bshig bco bcag grug brdeg bskyur 'gong g.yug sogs mi bya/ btsongs pa'i rin mi za/ bu lon gyi gta' mar byed pa dang rtse mo'i yo byad du bkol ba song dkon mchog la brnyas par 'gro ba'i rigs spu tsam mi bya bar gus par bya/ chos la skyabs su song nas dam pa'i chos kyi rten yi ge 'bru gcig yan chod la sgrib pa mi gsog cing phyag mchod bkur sti bya tshul gong bzhin dang*/ theg pa dang grub mtha' chos lugs gang la'ang skur pa mi gdab cing dag snang sbyang*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas ngur smrig gi rtags tsam 'chang ba yan chod la 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog tu 'du shes bskyed nas gus pas bkur sti bya 52)zhing*/ bstan pa'i sgor bzhugs so 'tshal la log blta chags sdang kun slong spang nas ci nus kyi zhabs tog sgrubs khyad par du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i gang zag ni khyim pa'am rab tu byung ba rtags dang cha lugs ji lta bur snang na'ang theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed cig gus par bya'o/ ༈ de ltar dkon mchog so so'i bslab bya bstan nas/ de rnams thun mong gi bslab bya lnga ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba rnams/ rnam pa thams cad du nor gyi bya dga' chen po'i lus dang srog gi phyir yang dkon mchog gsum gyi spang*/

dgos don gal po che ci lta bu la thugs kyang dkon mchog la gdab pa las tabs gzhan ni btsal/ phyogs gang du 'gro yang phyogs der bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la 53)phyag bya zhing skyabs 'gro dang gsol ba gdab ste/ phyogs bcu thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ dus dang dus kyi mchod pa ci nus dang*/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis dkon mchog mchod cing*/ nang nub thams cad du skyabs su 'gro ba'i nyams len spel sbyang la 'bad rtsol du bya ba ste/ de ltar skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang dam tshig de dag blo nges shing lag len du thebs par mdzad dgos pa lags/ ༈ sbyor ba'i chos gsum pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i rim pa ni/ de yang khyed cag sngon gyi tshe rabs mang po'i dgong nas kyang bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bus da lta byang chub kyi rgyu dang lam la mos shing zhugs pa'i skabs ba can du gyur mod la/ deng yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la 54)skye bar byed pa yang bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba nyid gal che bas na/ yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags par bya ste/ de la bsod nams ma yin pa'i las gang bgyis pa'i gnyen por bsod nams kyi yan lag so so la 'bad pa ste/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi dbang gis yul khyad par can la ma gus pa'i gnyen por phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ 'dod pa dang ser sna'i skyon gyis mchod 'os la bsnyen cig bkur bar ma byas pa'i gnyen por mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ thogs med nas bag chags ngan goms kyi skyon las/ bya bar mi rung ba'i las ngan bgyis pa'i gnyen por sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ phra dog gi mthus gzhan gyi yon la smod cing dge ba la bar chod byas pa'i gnyen por rjes su yi rangs 55)sgom pa/ gti mug gi dbang gis dam pa'i chos spangs pa'i gnyen por chos 'khor bskul ba dang*/ zhe sdang dang gnod sems kyi skyon gyis skyed bu dam pa la bsam sbyor log pa byas pa'i gnyen por mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa/

dge rtsa la yid mi ches pa dang*/ log min du bsngos pa'i gnyen por dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo ba ste/ bdun po 'di bsod nams gsog pa'i thabs ma lus pa 'du zhing byang chub du sems bskyed pa'i mthun rkyen mchog tu gyur pa lags pas/ des na tshogs kyi zhig dang rten du gyur pa ni dngos su bshams pa'i dkon mchog gi rten khyad par can rnams dang*/ yid kyis gsal ba'i rten mdun gyi nam mkhar dkon mchog 56)rin po che rnams dang gzhan yang bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung gi tshogs ma tshang ba med par bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzad/ de tsam du ma zad de phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab ro ro'i khyon la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa bzhugs pa'i tshul ni 'o skol po skye'i blos dpag cig gzhal ba'i yul du ma gyur la/ zhing khams de thams cad kyi rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyis mi mkhyen mi gzing pa ni skra rtse brgyar bshag pa'i cha skam yang mi srid pa na/ de thams cad la phyag mchod dag yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba'i yul du nye bar dmigs pa dang*/ ༈ ji ltar 'bul ba'i thabs kyi dang por/ khyed cag rang rang gi lus 57)'di gcig pu ma yin par rang nyid ci lta bu'i phyag 'tshal ba po bye ba grangs mang po yid kyis sprul pa dang*/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can kun kyang lhag gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal bar dmigs la/ 'di skabs yan lag bdun gyi 'don cha ni ding sang phal cher spyod 'jug gi gzhung bzhin mdzad srol mang na'ang*/ 'dir ni rgyal ba grangs med pa'i sku dang zhing khams kyi yon tan gang gis ba spu'i khungs gcig la rdzogs pa'i go 'phang brnyes kyang sems don du byang sems kyi tshul bstan nas smon lam bden pa la mnga' mdzad pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang pos gsungs pa bzhin bya ste/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po cho phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nam mkhas gang khyab na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la

58)bdag lus grangs med du sprul ba de rnams dang skye 'gro mtha' dag gus phyag 'tshal bar mos pa mdzad nas tshig 'di rjes bzlogs mdzad par zhu/ ༈ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng gi kun/ bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ bzhag po spyod pa'i smon lam stob dag gis/ rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du/ zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu/ mig gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur mdzad pa/ rin chen byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba sngon du song nas/ gnyis pa 59)mchod pa 'bul ba'i dang por bstod dbyangs kyi mchod pa ni/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po snyan dang ngag mkhan du gyur tshe bde gshegs rtsa mchog la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod nas byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus lta bu lhag bsam gyis bstod dbyangs phul ba ni mchod pa'i rab tu 'gyur zhing*/ rgyal ba rnams la bstod pas mnyes pa dag smad pas mi dgyes pa lta bu'i 'dzin rtog las 'das kyang*/ rang nyid bstod pa'i bsod nams tshad med thob pa ni rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel yin phyir/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten re re'i rdul phra rab kyi khyon re la zhing khams grangs med par bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad la dbyangs kyi yan lag mtha' yas pas rgyal ba'i yon tan la mngon 60)par bsngags pa bdag nyid kyi sprul tshogs dang 'gro kun lhan cig pas bstod pa byed par mos la 'di bzhin rjes zlos mdzod/ ༈ rdul gcig steng na rdul rnyed sangs rgyas rnams/ sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ thams cad rgyal ba bdag gis gang bar mos/

de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyi/ rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag dngos la/ da lta 'dir ngos su bshams pa'i mchod rdzas 'di dag dmigs rten mtshon byed tsam ste/ don la 'di dag re ro las kyang mchod pa'i dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dod pa'i yon tan gang la ci dgos zad med du 61)'byung bar dmigs shing*/ gzhan yang gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing na 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i bye brag ci yod pa thams cad kyang*/ 'o sko rnams lta bu'i rmongs pa blo chung gi sems khog tu chud pa dka' na'ang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi stobs tshad med pa'i bden pas byin gyis rlabs kyis sangs rgyas sras bcas ma lus pa'i spyan sngar mchod sprin nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur bar dmigs shing*/ rang nyid kyi lus longs spyod gtan 'dun thams cad kyang ltos med du 'bul ba'i mos pa dang bcas pas rjes zlos 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ me tog dam pa 'phreng ba dam pa dang*/ sil snyan rnams dang byugs pa bdug mchog dang*/ mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ 62)rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi/ na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*/ phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*/ bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i tshogs kun gyis/ rgyal bad de dag la yang mchod par bgyi/ mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stob dag gis/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la rtag tu ni/ bdag gi lus kun gtan du 'bul bar gyis/ sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig gus par khyod kyis 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ ༈ gsum pa bla ma'i byang chub la bgegs su byed pa ni dug gsum gyis kun nas blangs pa'i mi dge ba rnams yin te/

'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug 63)gsum/ des bskyed las ni mi dge ba/ zhes pa de sbyang zhing dag par byed pa'i thabs la/ rang gzhan mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog med nas da lta yan gyi mi dge sdig pa'i las rang gis bgyis pa dang gzhan la dgyid du bcug pa dang sdig pa la rjes su yi rangs pa'i las ngan mtha' dag la dug 'thung ba lta bu'i 'gyod pa drag po bskyed pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs yin la/ de'i gnyen por tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi las la brtson pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ phyin chad sdig pa srog la babs kyang mi dgyid pa'i dam bca' bzung ba ni nyes pa las bzlog pa'i stobs dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drug du sdig bshags skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la 'bad pa ni rten gyi stobs/ 64)te/ de ltar stob bzhi'i sgo nas bshags na sdig pa tshan po che ji lta bu yag sbyong bar nus te/ sngon rgyal po ma skyes dgra 'tsham med pa lnga tshang bar byas pa'i sdig po che yang*/ rang dang mkha' khyab kyi sems can lhan cig pa'i sdig pa bshags pas skad cig tsam la dag par gyur pa'i mos pa bzhin/ khyed cag rang rang gi sdig sgrib gang ci yod pa rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa yang byang bar dmigs pa dang*/ slan chad sdig par gyur pa gtan mi dgyid pa'i dam bca' dang ldan pa'i ngang nas rjes zlos 'di bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yod kyis kyang*/ sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ bdag ni khyod kyis yongs su bzung bas na/ 65)srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par dgyid/ sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' dgyid cing*/ sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi dgyid do/ ༈ bzhi pa gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang zhing dag snang dang dga' ba sgom pa ni rang nyid kyis dge rtsa bgyid pa dang khyad med ཿpa'i bsod nams thob ste/

sngon rgyal po gsal rgyal gyid de bzhin pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa la zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa'i yo byad rgya chen pos bsnyen cing bskur ba de dbul po des pa sogs sprang po lnga brgya'i tshogs kyis mthong bas/ bdag cag bsod nams dman pas sangs rgyas mchod par rngo ma thob mod kyi/ rgyal pos 'di lta bu mchod pa ni ngo mtshar che'o snyam pa'i yi rangs byas pa de sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen phyir 66)nyin drug gi bar du dge ba bsngo ba ni sprang po yi rangs sgoms mkhan rnams la dmigs nas mdzad pa'i lo rgyus ltar/ rjes su yi rangs kyis bsod nams dpag tu med pas/ khyed cag gis kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun na rgyal ba sras bcas rnams skyis zag med ye shes kyi tshogs chen rgyun chad med pa dang*/ gzhan yang nyan rang so skye mchog dman bar ma kun gyis 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ci lta bu bsags pa mtha' dag la rjes su yi rangs shing*/ de thams cad bar chad med par 'grub par gyur cig snyam pa'i ngang nas rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ ༈ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*/ 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*/ de dag kun gyi 67)rjes su bdag yi dang*/ ༈ lnga pa gti mug gi gnyen por chos 'khor bskul ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du byon pa de dam pa'i chos bstan pas sems can smin grol du mdzad pa las gzhan pa'i don ma mchis rung*/ dam pa'i chos ni 'byung ba dkon la de yang so so'i skal ba dang gsol ba 'debs po la ltos pa las nam yin gsung ba mi srid cing*/ bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong la yang tshangs pas gsol ba ma btab bar du chos 'khor mi bskor ba yin phyir khyed cag rnams kyi dad pa dang lhag bsam gyi mthu las sprul pa'i tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa re 'thog pa grangs med par sprul nas phyogs

68)bcu mtha' yas na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba re re'i drung du tshangs pa re song ste/ 'khor lo phul zhing chos gsung bar gsol ba 'debs par mos pas rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ ༈ gang na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgrol ma rnams/ byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brjes/ mgon po de dag bdag gi thams cad la/ 'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul/ ༈ drug pa gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lag ni/ 'o skol 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sgron ma'i bskal ba dang mun pa'i skal pa gnyis las/ sangs rgyas byon te chos gsungs te bstan pa gnas pa ni sgron bskal dang*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas chos nus pa ni mun bskal te/ mun bskal khri phrag mang po'i bar mtshams su sgron 69)bskal re re tsam las mi 'byung bas sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni dkon zhing*/ sangs rgyas zag med yos kyi sku la skye 'chi'i mtshan ma las 'das kyang*/ gdul bya'i rtag 'dzin gzhig phyir zhi ba'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das 'da' tshul ston par mdzad pa rnams la gsol btab na/ gang rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la dbang thob pas bskal ba'am bskal ba las lhag par yang bzhugs par 'gyur ro/ zhes sangs rgyas nyid kyi gsungs pas na/ khyed cag rang rang byang chub sems dpa' 'am mos pa dang smon lam la dbang thob pa lag na 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi 'thogs

pa grangs med par gyur te/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mya ngan las 'da' bzhed pa gang mchis kyi spyan sngar rang nyid re re 70)'khod nas 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi phul zhing thal mo sbyar bas/ ji srid 'gro ba thams cad byang grol la mkhyod kyi bar du mya ngan las 'da' tshul mi ston par gsol ba 'debs par dmigs nas rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ bskal pa zhing gi rdul rnyed bzhugs par yang*/ bdag gi thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar dgyid/ ༈ bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ de yang dge ba'i rtsa ba ci ltar bsags pa thams cad la bsngo ba'i rgyas ma thebs na gong du mi 'phel bar zad par 'gyur la/ gnas min du bsngos na byang chub kyi rgyur mi 'gyur gyi khar bgegs su 'gyur phyir/ dge ba che chung gang yang sems can thams cad byang chub thob pa'i rgyur bsngo dgos pa nyid do/ yum sher 71)phyin las/ deg ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs pa nyan thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo bar mi bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang*/ byang chub tu bsngo ba'i thabs dang tshul ji lta ba rang cag so skyes shes par ma gyur na'ang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang kun bzang sogs kyis ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin bdag gis kyang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ zhes pas kyang zab mo'i bsngo bar 'gyur te/ ci'i phyir na/ bdag dang 'gro kun gyi dge rtsa rnams byang chub kyi rgyu ru dmigs pa de ni mtshan bcas sam dmigs bcas kyi bsngo ba yin la/ don dam pa'i bsngo ba ni dmigs mtshan gyis ma bslad pa'i 'khor gsum 'khor gsum yongs dag nyid yin mod kyi/ de'i tshul ji lta ba ni 'o skol 72)las dang po pas rtogs par dka' phyir 'phags pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brang nas bsngo bar bya ba yin pas 'di bzhin rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ ༈

phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dngas/ rjes su yi rangs bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ dge ba cung zad bdag gzhan ci bsags pa/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dngas/ kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*/ dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ ༈ de ltar 'di yan chad kyis sems bskyed pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim rnams legs par grub pa lags/ ༈ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la yang dang por sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang*/ sems skyed kyi yon ci 'byor 73)'bul bar gsungs te/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyang byang chub kyi spyod pa'i skabs su 'byor pa'i khyad par sna tshogs byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa grags sbyin 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur tshe bde gshegs zla ba'i tog la gtsug lag khang bye ba phrag phul nas byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ bde gshegs bkod pa'i rgyal po 'khor bsgyur gyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba'i 'od la bai ḍūr+ya'i khang bzang phul nas thugs bskyed tshul sogs dang*/ 'byor pa chung bas ni chung ngu phul bas kyang 'grub ste/ bde gshegs 'od 'phro grong khyer gyis 'tsho ba sar gyur tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtha' yas la rtsa'i sgron me zhig phul nas thugs bskyed pa dang*/ bde gshegs seng ge 74)tshem bu sar gyur pa na de bzhin gshegs pa nga ro snyan pa la phyag bdar khrod kyi lhan pa thal mo tsam zhig phul nas thugs bskyed pa dang*/ bde gshegs yon tan 'phreng ldan dbul par gyur tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'gyingangs ldan bzhud la thal mo sbyar bas phyag len gsum btsal nas thugs bskyed tshul sogs mtha' yas pa mchis pas na/ khyed cag gis kyang bdag slob dpon la sems bskyed kyi yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/

༈ de nas smon 'jug gi cho ga dngos ni gong du smos pa bzhin shing rta'i srol gnyis po gang las blangs yang chog pa las/ rten khyim pa pho mo lta bu mthun mong ba'i slob ma la 'bogs na/ 'jam dbyangs dang klu sgrub sogs las brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar 'bogs pa'i thabs la smon 'jug gnyis kyi dang por blo sbyang ba ni/ ༈ da ni khyed rang rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub 75)kyi sems bskyed rgyu'i ngo bo de gang lta bu zhig yin snyam na/ nam mkhas gar khyab kyi 'jin thams cad kyi skye 'gro sems can gyis ma khyab pa med/ sems can gyis gar khyab las dang nyon mongs khyab/ des gar khyab sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa yin tshe/ skye 'gro mtha' dag sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba sna tshogs kyis rtag tu gzir zhing mnar ba yin na'ang*/ sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal sum shes pas da dung 'khor ba gtan 'khyam du byed pa'i rgyu thabs 'ba' zhig sgrub pa 'di thams cad ni rang gi tshe rabs thog med kyi drin can pha ma sha stog tu gyur pa rnams la phral dang yun gyi bde ba sgrub phyir/ rang nyid kyi sgo gsum gtan 'dun dang bcas pa 'gro ba kun gyi ched du gtong ba la bslabs dgos te/ sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad byang chub kyi 76)spyad pa spyod tshe rgyal srid bu dang chung ma bang mdzod ma lus btang ba lta ci smos te/ rang gi mig dang mgo dang yan lag sha khrag thams cad sems can la ltos med du btang bas byang chub brnyes pa yin na'ang*/ 'o skol rnams rang nyid kho na la gces par bzung ste/ phyi nas dgos dang rgyan gyi ni spungs/ nang nas zas dang skom gyis ni brgyangs/ zas gos tsam sgrub pa'i don ma'ang sdig pa mi dge dang g.yo rgyu zol zog sna tshogs shig byed cing*/ nam gzhag gtan don byang chub sgrub pa'i 'dun pa til 'bru tsam yang yid la mi 'khor bar 'di 'dra bas mi tshe yud kyi 'da' te/ yang yang skye shing 'byung 'jug gi 'khor los 'khor bar gtan 'khyams su gyur tshul 'di la legs par bsam nas/

da phyin chad nas rang lus longs spyod bde dge bsod nams pa ci dang ci yod pa mtha' dag pha 77)ma mkha' mnyam gyi sems can la phan pa dag bde ba'i don kho na'i ched du btang bar bya'o snyam pa'i sems brtan zing snying stobs kyi go cha skyed do/ tshig 'di rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ de ltar 'di dag kun byas pa'i/ dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*/ des ni mkha' mnyam sems can gyi/ sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*/ dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ phangs pa med par gtang bar bya/ thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'/ bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa sgrubs/ thams cad gtong ba chab gcig la/ sems can rnams la gtong ba mchog bdag gis lus can thams cad las/ lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyi/ rtag tu gso 78)dang smod pa'am/ brdog sogs ci dgar byed la rag bdag gi lus la 'tshe byed dam/ co 'dri ga sha'i rgyu byed kyang*/ bdag gi lus 'di byin zin gyi/ 'di yi kha das ci zhig bya/ de la gnod pa mi 'gyur ba'i/ las gang yin pa byed du chug bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang*/ 'ga' mang don med ma gyur cig bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis/ khro 'am dad pa'i sems byung ba/ de nyid rtag tu de dag gi don kun 'grub pa'i rgyud gyur gcig gang dag bdag la kha zer ram/ gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa'am/ de bzhin 'phyar kha gtong yang rung*/ thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur/ bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*/ brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni/ gzings dang zam pa nyid gyur rig 79) gling don gnyer la gling dang ni/ gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*/ bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa/ kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang*/ rig sngags grub dang sman mchog dang*/ dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*/ lus can rnams la 'dod 'jor shog

sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*/ nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*/ sems can dpag tu med pa dang*/ rnam mang nyer 'cho'i gzhir yang shog de bzhin bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtug pa'i/ sems can khams la rnam kun tu/ thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du/ bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog ༈ des ni byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa dang snying stobs khyad par can la blo sbyang ba yin te/ tshul 'di la blo 80)ma 'byongs ba ni bh+yang bsdom len pa'i thabs nam kyang mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dang por 'di lta bu la blo nges par bya dgos la/ de nas byang chub kyi sems dngos ni/ de+u nga 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad don dam par spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i rang bzhin stong pa nid las ma 'das kyang*/ kun rdzob kyi 'char sgo 'gags med las 'khor 'das bdag gzhan bde sdug sogs du mar/ nga zhing*/ ji ltar snang yang don la bden par grub pa rdul phra rab tsam yang med cing*/ med bzhin snang la snang bzhin bden par ma grub pa ni chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid yin yang*/ sems can rnams kyis de lta bu'i tshul ma rtogs pas med snang 'khrul pa'i dpag chags la bden zhen a 'thas te/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' med pas rtag tu nyams thag pa 'di thams cad drin can pha ma 'ba' 81)zhig yin tshe bdag gis bde la 'god dgos/ bkod par byed pa la rang nyid la de'i nus pa ma mchis pas na/ byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par myur du 'bad pa'i sems sngar ma skyes pa de da lta rten 'brel rgyu rkyen tshang ba la brten nas bskyed pa lags shing*/ de lta bu sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa zhe thag pa nas skyes pa de smon pa byang chub kyi sems yin/ de ltar smon pa tsam la bzhag pas mi chog ste/ dper na chu'i pha rol tu sgrol bar 'dod pas gru gzings kyi nang du zhugs kyang*/ skya bas g.yab pa'i rtsol ba ma byas par pha rol du sgrol bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin/

'jug pa byang chub kyi sems 82)blangs nas pha rol du phyin pa drug la sogs pas sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs la nye bar brtson pa la rag las pa de lta bu'i gnad don thugs la 'byor dgos pas na sems skyed blangs nas sems can thams cad byang chub la 'god par bya snyam pa smon sems kyi dngos don yin mod kyi/ skabs 'dir zab mo lta rgyud lugs kyi phyag bzhes gang zag dbang po rab kyi dbang du mdzad nas smon 'jug gnyis ka stabs gcig tu len pa lags phyir/ bla ma dkon mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang*/ sems can sdug bsngal las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang*/ de'i phyir bla na med pa'i byang chub thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa gsum rtse gcig tu bskyod de/ phyag thal mo sbyar zhing yod gzhan du ma yengs pa'i ngang nas sdom pa len pa'i 83)tshig 'di rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ ༈ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyi/ byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ byang chub sems ni bskyed gyi zhing*/ de bzhin du na bslab pa la/ rim pa bzhin du slob par bgyi'o/ ༈ des khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub sems dpa'i smon 'jug ti sdom 84)pa'i cha shas tshas gsum gyi zla ba tsam zhig rgyud la skyes pa yin pas de ltar nges shes bskyed cing*/ yang ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems de dag gis sems thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon sems dang*/ 'jug pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims gsum la rim pas slob par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag gi kyang smon 'jug gnyis pal bslab par bya'o snyam pa snying thag pa nas bsam pa dang bcas lan gnyis pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/

zhes brjod nas gong gi de ka rjes zlos byar gzhug ༈ des khyed kyi rgyud la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cha shas tshes brgyad kyi zla ba tsam zhig skyes pa'i nges shes mdzad 'tshal/ yang*/ bla ma dkon mchog la 85)mos gus dang*/ pha ma sems can la snying rje/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa rnams cher bskyed de/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi smon 'jug gi thugs bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa gsum la gnas par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag gi kyang ci nas ci la thug kyang smon 'jug gi sdom pa blangs shing byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa gsum dang phar phyin drug la brtson nas myur du sangs rgyas thob pa dang sems can thams cad byang chub la 'god par bya'o snyam pas rjes zlos gsum pa mdzad pa zhu/ zhes pas snga ma ltar rjes zlos byar gzhug ste/ des khyed cag la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yongs su rdzogs pa tshes bco lnga'i zla 88)ba lta bur rgyud la skye zhing thob pa yin pas de ltar thob par nges shes skyed dgos te/ ci'i phyir na/ nged kyi bsdom pa legs par phogs rung khyed la thob sems kyi nges shes ma brnyed na thob par mi 'gyur ba lags/ 'o na de lta bu'i sdom pa thob pa'i gtan tshigs ci yin rnyam na/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel 'byung gi rang bzhin yin pa dang*/ khyod kyi rgyud la bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po byang chub kyi sems 'dus ma byas pa gzod nas lhun grub tu yod pa de gnas skabs rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pas mtshams sbyar nas/ rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo byang chub kyi sems rin po cher bsgrub pa 'di'i rten 'brel gyis/ dge ba'i bya ba che chung 87)mtha' dag la byang chub sems kyis rtsis zin pas tshogs rlabs po che 'phel zhing sgrib pa byang*/ bsam pa dag pas lus byin gyis rlobs/ lus kyi snang ba byin gyis brlabs te/

phyi nang thams cad byang chub sems kyi 'khor lor grub pas gzhan don 'bad med du 'byung zhing*/ tshe rabs kun tu byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyun gyis sangs rgyas kyi sa bon thebs pa lags/ ༈ des sems bskyed dngos gzhi'i cho ga legs par grub nas/ gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la/ dga' ba sgom pa/ bslab bya bstan pa/ bka' drin btang rag dang byang sems mi brjid gong 'phel gyi smon lam gdab pa dang gsum yod pa'i 88)dang po ni/ 'di bzhin thugs la bsam 'tshal te/ bdag 'khor ba thog ma med nas da lta yan du lus de tsam zhig blangs shing las de tsam zhig byas pa thams cad don med 'khrul 'khor 'ba' shig las sangs rgyas kyi rgyud du gang yang ma song ba la/ da res 'di lta ba'u'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che phan bde thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'di brnyed pa re dga'/ re 'tshengs/ snyam pa'i dga' ba dang spro bas bskyed cing*/ da ni 'di 'dra ba'i rnyed pa legs par brnyed pa 'di don med du ma song ba'i rigs dang dang mthun pa'i las la brtson dgos snyam du dam 'cha' ste/ rigs gang yin na sangs rgyas kyi rigs te/ rigs bde gyur nas de'i las byang chub kyi spyod pa mi brtsal du 89)mi rung ba'i phyin na/ nges par byang chub sems dpa'a'i spyod pa la brtson par bya zhing*/ de ltar brtson nang 'grub par 'gyur ba'i rgyud dang gtan tshigs ni/ spyod 'jug las/ long bas phyag dar phung po las/ ji ltar rin chen brnyed pa ltar/ de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas/ bdag la byang chub sems 'di skyes/ 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i/ bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'di yin no/ 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel byed pa'i/ mi zad gter yang 'di yin no/ 'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i/ sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ srid lam 'khyams zhing dub pa yi/ 'gro ba ngal gso'i 90)ljon shing yin/

'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las/ skyobs par byed pa'i saḥpayi bstegs yin/ 'gro ba'i nyon mong gdung sel ba'i/ sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin/ 'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag dpyid 'byin nyi ma chen po yin/ dam chos 'o ma bsrub pa la/ mar gyi nying khu phyungs pa yin/ zhes pa de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems yod pas ci'i phyir 'gro ba'i don mi 'grub snying stobs dang dga' spro bskyod nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad 'tshal/ ༈ deng dus bdag che 'bras bu yod/ mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ da ni bdag gi ci nas kyang*/ rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ 91)skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ ༈ zhes pa de lta bu'i dga' ba bsgom pa la dgos pa ci lta bu yod ce na/ byang chub sems kyi yon tan la nges pa brnyed nas byang sems mi nyams par bsrung ba dang dag pa spel ba dang mthar phyin pas dgos pa yod/ rang nyid la de lta bu'i skal zabang thob paḥs 'gro ba gzhan rnams kyang lam mkhan gyi deng dpon nam/ dmus long la dmigs long khrid bu mun 'khyams la sgron me/ nad pa la sman pa brnyed pa lta bur bdag gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug thams cad la phan bde sgrub pas khyod cag dga' ba dang spro bar gyis bar gzengs bstod pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ༈ bdag gis 92)de ring skyabs pa thams cad kyi/ spyan sngar 'gro la bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi/ lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ 'gro ba'i 'gron pa srid pa'i lam 'khyams shing*/ bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la/ 'dis ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas nas/ sems can 'gron chen tshim par byed pa yin/ ༈ gzhan yang rigs kyi bu rnams shes par gyis shig 'di lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed ma thag sangs rgyas kyi sras su gyur pa yin te/

spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur nas skad cig gis/ bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*/ 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 93)'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ sngon gyi sdig pa tshan po che thams cad kyang 'dis byang bar 'gyur te/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ skad cig tsam gyis nges par sreg par byed/ ces gsungs bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob ste/ dpal byin gyi mdor/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*/ gal te de las gzugs mchis na/ nam mkha'i ni kun bkangs nas/ de ni de las chos lhag 'gyur/ zhes gsungs sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa'i mchog tu yang 'gyur/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi mdo las/ lus can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ byang chub ku ni sems bskyed nas/ mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis ldan pa'i/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod 94)par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i mchog yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen po gcig su tshad med blos/ legs par yongs su brtag na rin chen che ba/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bral bar 'dod pa na/ rin chen byang chub sems legs brtan par bzung*/ zhes gsungs/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rtsa ba tshugs te myur du rdzogs sangs rgya bar 'gyur ba ni/ byang chub sems pa'i sa las/ sems bskyed pa de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rtsa ba yin no/ sems bskyed na mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i phyir myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ zhes pa la sogs byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod pas 95)mi lang ba lags pa yang thugs la nges 'tshal/ ༈ de ltar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa legs par thob nas/ mjug don gnyis pa spang blang gnas nye bar ston pa'i bslab bya brjod pa 'di la thugs ma yongs pas legs par gsan 'tshal te/

de yang zab mo lta rgyud lugs kyi smon 'jug gnyis las dang po smon pa'i bslab bya ni/ ji skad du/ sems can gcig yang blos yi spang*/ rtag par sems de'i phan yon bsam/ tshogs gnyis gsag la brtson par bya/ yang yang byang chub sems gnyis sbyangs/ nag po'i chos bzhi yang spangs nas ni/ dkar po'i chos bzhi bsten par bya/ zhes gsungs pa rnams yin te/ de yang*/ nam 96)mkhas gar khyab kyi sems can thams cad la phan pa sgrub par dam bcas pa yin phyir/ rang dang ma mthun pa'am mi dga' ba gcig tsam zhig blos spangs te khong khro dang dgrar 'dzin byas na byang chub smon sems nyams pa yin phyir de lta bu su la yang mi bya ba 'di ni byang sdom gyi gzhi ma'o/ ༈ rtag tu byang chub sems kyi phan yon la bsam zhing dran gso bar bya/ dge ba'i bya ba nga byed kyang sems bskyed kyis zin pa dang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi rgyas thobs pa'i tshogs gnyis zung 'jug la bslab/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyang zhing nyin mtshan gyi thun du sems bskyed blang ba dang gzhan gyi sdig sdug rang la len cing rang gi dge bde gzhan la sbyin pa'i nyams len ni 'di'i don 97)gyi dngos gzhi'o/ nag po'i chos bzhi ni/ bla ma'am dkon mchog tu gtogs pa dang mched grogs sogs la rdzun dag ngan g.yos bslu ba dang*/ gzhan gyis dge ba byas pa sogs 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod du bcug pa dang*/ sems skyed ldan pa'i gang zag gzhan la skur ba 'debs shing ma gus pa dang*/ skye 'gro sems can mchog dman gang dang gang la g.yo sgyu zol rdzun gyi rigs dang thabs 'phrul rtsi lta bus bslus pa dag bzhi po ni nag po'i chos bzhi yin la/ de dag spangs te/ dus nam du'ang srog la bab kyang rdzun mi smra ba/ gzhan gyi dge ba la yid rangs dang mthun rkyen sgrub cing 'brel tshad dge la 'god ci nus bya ba dang*/ 98)spyir chos pa dang khyad par theg chen sems skyed dang ldan pa'i gang zag la sangs rgyas dngos su lta ba'i dang gus zhabs togs sgrub pa dang*/

sems can thams cad pha mar shes pas zol med kyi lhag bsam rnam dag gis ci phan la 'bad pa ste/ dkar po'i chos bzhi po 'di dal rtag tu brtson par bya ba 'di dag ni smon pa byang sems kyi nyams len lag pas phyag len du thobs par mdzad dgos/ mdor bsdu na/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa'i mdor/ byang chub sems dpa' chos gcig dang ldan na rnams pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su 'dzin te/ chos gcig pu ga nga zhe na sems can blos yongs su mi gtong ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag las gzhan gces kyi byang sems zol med la 'du 99)ba'o/ de nas yang 'jug pa byang sems kyi bslab bya la/ gzhung so sor 'dren lugs mi gcig pa dag la mchis rung*/ zab mo lta rgyud kyi skabs 'dir ni nam mkha' snying po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang ste slob dpon zhi ba lhas bslabs rus su gsungs pa ni/ dkon mchog gi dkor 'phrog pa/ dam pa'i chos spangs ba/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags can la chad pas gcod pa'am/ btson du 'jug gam dmag dang 'u lag sogs las min la bkol ba dang*/ 'tsham med pa lnga gang rung byed pa/ dge sdig khyad du gsod pa'i chad par lta ba 'dzin pa ste/ byang sems rgyal po'i rtsa ltung lnga/ de rnams kyi khar*/ grong {

chad lta 'dzin pa dang grong khyer 'joms pa 'di gnyis brjes/ }dang grong khyer grong rdal yul 'khor sogs 'joms pa'am gnod 'tshe byed pa 100)ni byang sems blon po'i rtsa ltung zhes bya la/ srog gcod ma byin len mi tshangs spyod snun smra ste rtsa ba bzhi po las 'gal ba dang*/ snod ma yin pa la stong nyid ston pa dang*/ theg chen la mos pa'i dad can phyir bzlog pa dang*/ so thar spangs nas theg chen la dkri ba dang*/ slob ma'i mos pa dang mi mthun pa ston pa dang*/ rnyed dang bkur sti 'dod nas bdag bstod gzhan smod dang*/ mi shes bzhin shes brdzu ma rtogs par rtogs brdzu ma thob par brdzu sogs mi chos bla ma'i zol dang*/ sgrub gra'i yo byad bshad sgra la sbyar ba'am sbyor du 'jug cing*/ dkon mchog gi dkor rgyal po'am nye du sogs la sbyin par byed pa ste/ de ltar rgyal blon gyi rtsa ltung bcu dang las dang po pa'i ltung 101)ba brgyad rnams thams cad 'dzom zhing spong bar bya ba la bslab dgos pas na/ 'di rnams kyi spang blang gi nags ji lta ba shes par bya zhing*/ 'di dag las gzhan pa'i yan lag gi ltung byed brgyad cu song phra zhib dag ni khyed cag gi snod dang 'tshal pa'am shes pa dang bsgrub par yang dka' la/ mod don phal cher gong du smos pa rnams la 'du ba dang*/ gal te cis kyang rtogs par nus shing spro na bslab btus sogs byang sems kyi mdo bstan bcos rnams la shes par bya la/ khyad par du/ skyabs dang smon sems gtong ba/ log par lta dang nyan rang gi yid byed skyes pa/ bslab pa phul dang sems can blos ma spang ba rnams ni byang sdom rtsa ba nas gtong zhing 'jig pa'i rgyu yin 102)phyir/ sdom bya'i gtso bo yin par shes dgos/ ltung ba cher byung na sdom pa slar blang ba dang*/ 'bring du byung bshags pa dang phra ba rnams mthun gyi bshags bsdom gyis sor chud par 'gyur gsungs/

spang bya'i dgag pa'i bslab bya de ltar bstan nas/ bsgrub par bya ba ni/ dge ba bcu dang chos spyod bcu/ pha rol phyin drug sogs la brtson pa dang*/ mdor bsdu na nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed ste/ tshul khrims rnam pa gsum la yang dag par gnas pa ni byang chub sems dpa' dpa'i bslab pa thams cad de la yongs su rdzogs pa lag pas de dag la nan tan tu mdzad 'tshal/ ༈ mjug gi las rim gsum pa btang rag gi mchod pa ni/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i gshegs 103)sdug bsngal dam pa 'di lta bur chud pa ni bla ma dkon mchog gi sku drin las byung ba yin pas na/ khyed cag rang rang gi lus longs spyod ci yod thams cad mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du 'bul ba'i 'dun pas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che tshe rabs kun tu mi brjed cing mkha' khyab kyi don rgya tshen 'grub pa'i bsngo smon bzang po 'di bzhin rjes zlos mdzad 'tshal/ ༈ byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cing*/ skyes pa nyams pa med par yang*/ gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*/ byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi yongs bzung ste/ bdud kyi 104)las kyang spong bar shog byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni/ 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa/ sems can rnams la bde 'byor shog ces dang shes pa yag brjod par bya'o/ 'di ni zab mo lta rgyud kyi lugs por bzhag yin phyir/ khyim pa pho mo la sogs rten nges med la skyabs bsdom gyi gzhi byas nas 'bogs par rung bar gsung zhing*/ bla ma ma 'dzoms na rten gyi drung du'ang len par rung bar gsung pa'o/ rgyal ba byams pa nas 'phags pa thogs med las brgyud pa'i rgya chen spyod rgyud lugs kyi byang sdom blang ba la/

rten gyi gang zag ni spyir gong dang mthun yang*/ khyad par du so thar res bdun gang rung dgos par gsungs phyir dge sbyong la bsngags shing*/ gal te khyim pa lta bu la cis kyang 'bogs dgos na'ang rang rang gi ji ltar nus pa dang sbyar 105) ba'i dge bsnyen du sgrub nas de rjes byang sdom 'bogs par gsungs shing*/ 'di la'ang sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum gyi/ sbyor ba'i cho ga gsol ba gdab pa skyabs 'gro khyad par can dang yan lag bdun gyi tshogs bsags pa gsum po gong du bstan pa ltar byas la/ 'di skabs phyag bzhes la lar phyag mchod cim las gzhan mi mdzad pa yang yod med kyi/ bsdus pa la de ltar rung yag 'dir ni yan lag bdun tshang bar bya ste/ byang sems rgyud la skye ba ni tshogs bsags pa la rag las par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ gal te dus gcig la sems sdom rgyud lugs gnyis ka sbrel nas 'bogs dgos pa lta bu'i tshe na sbyor chos gsum po 'di gnyis ka'i thun mong du tshar gcig gis chog pa nyid do/ dngos gzhi la de yang zab mo lta rgyud la ni smon 'jug stabs gcig tu blangs rung yang*/ 'dir ni nges par 106) tha dad du len pa phyag bzhes yin phyir/ slob ma rnams la yan lag bdun gyi bsngo ba yin rnams legs par grub nas/ dngos gzhi la babs pa'i tshe 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/ ༈ de nas dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed par byed pa'i gzhung lugs gnyis kyi/ 'dir ni byams mgon thogs med sogs las legs par brgyud cing jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i ring lugs las byung ba'i phyag bzhes la/ smon pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'jug pa byang chub sems kyi sdom pa blangs ba dang gnyis yod de/ dang po smon pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ sems can thams cad pha mar shes pa'i byams pa dang*/ de dag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la mi bzod pa'i snying rje dang*/

de dag sdug bsngal las skyabs phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod 107)pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang gsum dgos pa ste/ de yang sems can gyi rigs su gyur pa stong 'khor bsgyur gyi rgyal po nas 'jag mig gi srin bu yan chad sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta yan chad du rang nyid kyi pha ma byas pa'i grangs dang tshad ni sangs rgyas kyis kyang brjod du med la/ da dung sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du de las ma 'das/ 'o skol rnams skye ba 'di'i ma la 'di ni bdag gi drin can gyi ma'o zhes drin du bzo ba cung zad tsam byed pa las mi byed pa ches mang zhing*/ drin du bzo bar rlom pa rnams kyang zas dgos byin zhing g.yog tu bgyi ba phran tsheg byas na drin yul phar 'dren par byed pa las med/ ma 'dis ni rang gi sdug bsngal mtha' dag 108)khyad du bsad de bdag la lus srog longs spyod ma lus byin pa'i drin lan su zhig gi 'khor la/ de yang tshe 'di gcig pur byas pa tsam ma yin te 'khor ba thog med da lta'i bar du byas pa dang*/ 'don de lta bu'i drin che ba te tshe 'di'i ma 'di nyid kho na yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ khams gsum rim ris drug gi sems can thams cad re mos kyi pha ma byas pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas na/ de thams cad la khyad med du dri lan zhal dgos pas/ byams pa'i sems tshad med par bskyed par bya ba ni byang chub sems kyi sa bon nam rgyu'i dngos po yin te/ spyod 'jug la byang chub sems dpa' sems can la/ bu gcig ma yi bya ba bzhin/ rkang gis khongs nas byams pa che/ de ltar rtag 109)phan bya bar 'dod/ zhes pa ltar dgos shing*/ de lta bu byams pa yod pa gcig pus mi chog ste/ sems can de dag gi gnas tshul ci lta bu zhe na/ rgyu bde gshegs pa'i snying pos khyab kyang rkyen dge ba'i bshes kyis ni ma zin/ thob dam pa'i chos dang ni ma phrad/

las dkar po dge ba ni mi sgrub par/ mi rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags ngan goms ni tshan che/ nyon mongs las ngan gyi chu klung chen po ni shugs drag gtan bde thar pa byang chub kyi 'dun ma ni bstan yang mi mthong*/ bshad kyang mi go khrid kyang mi 'gro bar 'khor ba ngan song gi rgyu thabs sgrub pa la ni phye ma leb mar me la 'jug pa ltar bkag kyang mi khogs 110)bsrung yang mi thub par 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi sgo bshom dang 'dun thabs 'ba' zhig sgrub par byed do/ ji skad du/ sdug bsngal 'dor 'dos blo yod kyang*/ sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyugs/ bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ zhes pa de lta bu'i ma rgan rnams la snying rje drag po bskyed dgos/ de yang ngan song gi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa nyams su myong ba rnams lta bu snying rje'i yul du gyur mod kyi/ de las kyang da lta sdig pa tshad med par spyod pa la nyam nga spu tsam med pa'i rgyal po'am/ shan pa lta bu dag snying rtse ba'i yul yin te/ de dag da lta sdug bsngal mtha' med kyi rgyu sgrub pa la 'bad pa'i phyir ro/ de bas na mkha' khyab kyi 111)ma rgan smyon pa dang 'dra ba spang blang go log mkhan 'di dag sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras las bzlog cing skyob thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje bskyed par bya ste/ chos yang dag par bsdus pa'i mod las/ 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che gang du mchis pa der dpung gi tshogs thams cad mchi'o/ de bzhin du snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchi'o/ zhes dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de ni snying rje'i rtsa ba las byung ba yin no/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing*/ de ltar du snying rje ba'i sems can de thams cad bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang la bkod na gzhan gang gis kyang mi ldan la/

de la ni thog mar rang 112)nyid la mkhyen brtse nus gsum dang spang dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dang ma ldan par gzhan sgrol bar mi nus te/ ldongs pas gzhan gyi lam mkhan mi nus pa bzhin no/ de'i phyir rang nyid bla na med pa'i byang chub ci nas kyang myur du thob par byas la/ mkha' khyab kyi pha ma 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi sar nges pa kho nar 'god par bya'o snyam pa'i mdun pa dran pos/ bla ma dkon mchog rnams la dad pa'i shugs bskyed cing*/ thal mo thar nas smon sems blang ba'i tshig 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ ༈ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ skye ba 'di 113)dang skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ dgyid du stsal ba dang*/ dgyid pa la rjes su yi rangs ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji talar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa'e na po rnams kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du 114)bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par dgyi'o/ sems can ma { ngan song gsum gyi sems can sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las/ }rgal ba rnams bsgral bar dgyi'o/ ma { mtho ris kyi 'gro ba nyon mongs pa'i 'ching bas las/ }grol ba rnams 'grel bar dgyi'o/ dbugs { nyan rang gi tshogs theg pa chen por/ }ma phyin pa rnams dbyugs dbyung bar dgyi'o/ yongs { byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi sar/

}su mya ngan las 'das ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo bar dgyi'o/ zhes lan gsum du bskyar nas blangs te/ ༈ des smon pa byang chub kyi sems khyed cag rnams kyis legs par thob pa yin pas de lta bu'i nges shes skyes pa gsal che/ ji ltar 'jig rten na rgyal po'i sras rgyal srid la dbang bskur ma thag rgyal por brjod pa dang*/ rab tu blang 115)ma thag dge sbyong du ming 'pho ba bzhin/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed ma thag byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya bar 'gyur ba dang*/ nyan rang man chad kyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyag gi gnas su gyur pa lags/ byang chub kyi sems de rgyud la skye ba'i tshul yang*/ blo gros mi zad pa'i modar/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems dang po skyes pa de yang mi zad pa'o/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'dres pa'i phyir byang chub kyi sems de ni nyon mongs pa thams cad dang ma 'dres par skye'o/ theg pa gzhan las 'dod pa med pas sems de ni ma 'brel bar skye'o/ bdud thad kyis mi phyed pas sems de ni sra bar skye'o/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs pas sems de ni brtan nas skye'o/ 116)'dus byas mi rtags shin tu rig pas sems de ni rtag par skye'o/ sems can go 'byed pas sems de ni rgya che bar skye'o/ zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs shing*/ 'di lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che sangs rgyas thams cad thugs/ sems can thams cad kyi mgon/ gnas skabs mthar thug ma lus pa'i gtan 'dun gyi gzhi ma/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs 'di nyid rgyud la dang por skyes ma thag bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' de srung zhing skyobs par byed pa dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi mngong na dga' ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mi zad cing 'phel ba dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa bon thob pa la sogs/
