sems 117)dang po skyes pa tsam gyi phan yon gzhal du med par gsungs na/ rgyun chags su lag len du 'debs na lta ci smos te/ 'gro ba kun gyi dga' ba'i rgyu/ sems can sdug bsngal cir gyur pa/ rin chen sems kyi bsod nams gang*/ de la ji ltar gzhal gyis lang*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan dran zhing nges shes bskyed par mdzad nas/ de'i bslab bya rnams la slob dgos pa yin pas 'di bzhin thugs la nges 'tshal to/ bslab par bya ba'i gnas gang zhe na/ byang chub sems kyi phan yon mthong zhi rjes su dran par bya ba dang*/ de nyid nyin mtshan dus kun tu bsgom zhing spel sbyang la slob pa dang*/ tshogs gnis rgya cher 118)gsog pa la ngal dub dang rlom sems med par brtson pa dang*/ sems can gcig tsam yang blos mi spang bar skyabs khongs su bcug pa dang*/ nag po'i chos bzhi spangs nas dkar po'i chos bzhi la brtson pa rnams phyag len du thebs par mdzad 'tshal/ de la nag po'i chos bzhin ni/ bla ma dang mkhan slob sogs brdzun gyis bslu ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sogs chos spyod pa gzhan la bskur ba 'debs pa dang*/ gzhan gyi dge ba la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang*/ g.yo sgyus sems can bslu zhing log 'tsho sgrub pa rnams yin pas/ de dag las bzlog pa'i dkar po'i chos bzhi sgrub pa ni/ srog la babs kyang rdzun mi smra ba dang*/ gzhan la skur 'debs mi byed pa dang*/ 119)pha rol gyi dge ba las mthun 'gyur byed pa dang*/ su la yag g.yo sgyu zol zog mi bya ba ste/ de ltar smon pa byang sems kyi bslab bya 'di rnams las skad cig kyang mi 'da' bar mdzad par/ da ni 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi las rim la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas ston pa las/ sbyor ba'i chos la lnga yod de/ gsol ba gdab pa/ bsam pa brtag pa/ myur du sbyin par bskul ba/ bar chad dri ba bslab pa'i gnas go bar byas nas spro ba dri ba dang lnga yod pa'i/

dang po ni/ gong du smon pa byang chub kyi sems legs par thob pas byang chub kyi rgyu dang so bon nye bar thob kyang*/ de myur du sgrub par byed pa la 'jug pa 120)byang chub kyi sems med na 'grub par dka' ste/ ji ltar 'jig rten na zhing pa dag pa bon bzang po bskrun du zin yang chu lus sogs skyed sdung gi las la 'bad dgos pa lta bu ste/ jo bo chen pos/ 'jug sems bdag nid sdom pa ma gtogs pa/ yang dag smon pas 'phel bar 'gyur ma yin/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sdog pa spral 'dod pas/ de phyir de ni 'bad pas nges par blangs/ zhes gsungs pa de nid len pa'i rten du so thar ris bdun gyi bslab pa dang ldan zhing smon sems legs par skyes pa gcig dgos par lugs 'di'i bzhed pa yin pas/ de'i rgyud khyed cag la tshang ba dang*/ len pa'i yul dge ba'i bshes gnyen 121)la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang ldan pa dgos kyi/ nged la de lta bu'i yon tan gyi cha shas tsam yang med na'ang*/ khyed cag gis sangs rgyas dngos su mos pa mdzad na dad pa'i rgyu dang bdag gi byang chub kyi sems gnyis po 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel gyi mthus khyed kyi rgyud la 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems skyes/ de'i mthu 'bras kyi nam zhig bdag slob dpon pa dang po'i bden pa mthong ba'i tshe/ da lta khyed sems skyed zhugs pa rnams kyi las bzang ba dag ni lta ci smos kyi/ 'ga' zhig las ngan gyi ltung ba phog nas ngan song gi gnas na mchis pa'i tshe na'ang*/ bdag bsam bzhin de'i don du skye ba blangs te rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas 1222)pa na khyed 'brel pa thogs pa tshun chad la thugs rje'i gzigs pa 'jug cing*/ khams gsum gang na gnas kyang bdag gi sku'i 'od zer bye ba phrag drug cus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du bsdus nas smin cing grol bar byed par 'gyur ba ste/

byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig pa'i bden pa'i byin rlabs lags/ de'i phyir na da lta yang dag la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos pa mdzad nas lus longs spyod gtan srid mtha' dag mchod par 'bul ba'i thugs 'dun gyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ ༈ de nas phyag thal mo sbyar te gus pas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad 'tshal/ ༈ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon 123)khyed las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag pa blangs ba len par 'tshal gyi de la gnad pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad cig gsan cing stsal ba'i rigs so/

zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ ༈ gnyis pa bsam pa brtag pa la gsum yod pa'i dang po snying stobs la brtag pa ni/ rigs kyi bu rnams byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa len par 'dod pa ni shin tu legs shing ngo mtshar che na'ang*/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' ni sems can thams cad smin par byed dgos { zhes mkhas blang ngo*/ }na/ de'i bslab pa grangs med pa la slob dgos kyi/ rigs kyi bu rnams sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i 124)bslab pa rnams la slob nus sam/ zhes 'dri zhing*/ slob ma rnams kyis kyang*/ nus lags/ byang chub sems dpa' ni zhing khams grangs med sa sbyong ba dang*/ sangs rgyas grangs med pa mnyes par bya dgos na/ rigs kyi bu rnams zhing khams grangs med pa sbyong ba dang*/ sangs rgyas grangs med mnyes pa la slob nus sam/ slob mas kyang*/ nus lags/ zhes bya/ byang sems kyi sdom pa de nyams na sems can thams cad phan bde la 'god par dam bcas pa'i phyir de dag thams cad bslus par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ dngos po phal pa cung zad kyang*/ yid kyi sbyin par bsam byas nas/ mi gang sbyin par mi byed par/ de dag yi dgas rgyur gsungs nas/ bla na med pa'i bde ba la/ bsam pa thag pas mgron 125)gnyer nas/ 'gro ba thams cad bslus byas na/ bde 'gro ci ltar 'gro 'gyur ram/ zhes pa ltar sems can bslus pa'i rnam smin gyis dmyal ba sogs su skye bar 'gyur ba'i nyes dmigs shin tu che bar mchis na/ de lta bu la mi 'jigs sam/ ༈ mi 'jigs la gas/ zhes brjod/ mi 'jigs pa de yang rgyu 'bras khyad du bsod pas ngan song la mi 'jigs pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ ngan song de dag tu ltung mi dgos pa'i rgyu bslab pa ma nyams par byed nus pa'i snying stob dgos pa lags/ yang de nyid ma nyams par byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya la tshul bzhin slob na bsod nams kyi tshogs zad mi shes pa'i gter dang yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa dang*/

bla na med pa rdzogs 126)pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang dam pa thob par 'gyur bas na/ bsod nams kyi khyad par de lta bu thob par nus pa'i bslab pa la slob par spro'am/ zhes pa'i lan du/ spro lags/ ༈ gnyis pa shes rab la brtag pa ni/ tshe dang ldan pa ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod rnams byang chub sems dpa'i sdo snod kyi ma mo dag legs par thos sam/ zhes dris la/ cung zad thos lags/ zhes dang*/ sde snod de dag gi don gyi tshul zab mo rnams khyod kyis shes sam/ cung zad shes lags/ de dag gi gnas la dad dam/ shin tu dad lags/ de dag gi bsrung bya rnams bsrung bar nus sam/ nus lags/ zhes dri ba dang lan bya'o/ ༈ gsum pa 'dun pa la brtag pa ni/ 'gro ba gang dag gcig gam 'ga' tsam ma yin par mchog dman 127)'bring dang nam mkhas gar khyab thams cad byang chub la 'god pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan dgos phyir/ rigs kyi bu rnams 'di lta ste/ khyod kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang sgrub nas/ sems can ma rgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams 'grol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las zlo ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdu rgyun mi chad par bya ba'i 'dun pa dang ldan pa yin nam/ zhes dri zhing*/ de lta bu dang ldan pa lags so/ zhes lan gdab cing*/ de la khyed kyis sems bskyed pa brtan pa dang*/ yi dam brtan par bya dgos so/ gzhan yang rigs kyi bu khyod cag gis sems bskyed pa 'di gzhan la 'gran pa'i ched du ma yin nam/ gzhan dag gis 128)nan gyi len du bcug pa ma yin nam/ zhes dri zhing*/ ma yin lags/ zhes lan gdab tu gzhug so/ ༈ gsum ma myur du sbyin par bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de nas yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi che ba'i yon tan dran pa'i dad gus dang*/ bdag slob dpon la yag bka' drin gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas dngos su shes pa'i dag snang dang bcas pas/

snang srid snod bcud kyi dngos po bdag lus longs spyod mtha' dag mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du 'bul ba'i 'dun pa rtse gcig pas rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ ༈ dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul/ bdag pos yongs su ma bzung dang*/ bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ ma lus blo yis blangs te 'bul/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po kun/ 129)ma lus dkon mchog spyan sngar 'bul/ 'gro ba'i skyabs gyur 'tshang rgya shog ༈ de nas sems skyed kyi sdom pa thob par 'dod pa'i dung pa ches cher 'phel zhing dkon mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa bskyed de thal mo sbyar bas rjes zlos 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon khyed kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba bdag la myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab tu gzhug go ༈ bzhi pa bar chad dri ba ni/ de yang 'di ltar byang chub 'jug pa'i sems bskyed zab mo yang dag par len pa po ni thog mar smon pa byang chub tu sems legs par bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig dgos na/ rigs 130)kyi bu khyed cag smon sems yang dag par bskyed la ma nyams pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ zhes dri zhing slub mas/ yin lags/ zhes bya/ mkha' mnyam sems can la 'god phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par smon lam rlabs po che btabs pa gcig dgos na/ rigs kyi bu rnams byang chub tu smon lam legs par btab bam/ zhes dres pa'i lan du/ de ltar btabs lags so/ ces bya'o/ lnga pa bslab pa'i gnas go bar byas nas spor ba dri zhing sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ rigs kyi bu rnams/ da ni yon tan mi zad pa dpag tu med pa bla na ma mchis pa'i bsod nams kyi gter/ sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' dag rang gi rgyud la bgegs med du skye bar byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa myur du thob par 'gyur gyi/

de'i snying po ni/ sgo gsum 131)gyi mi dge ba mtha' dag spongs ba'i sems ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims pha rol tu du phyin pa drug pa sogs pa rgyal ba sras bcas kyi rnam thar la slob cing sgrub pa ni dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ rang nyid zhi bde sgrub pa ma yin par sems can thams cad kyi don ngal ba med par ci nus kyi spyod pa ni sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te/ tshul khrims rnam pa gsum po 'di la byang chub sems dpa' bslab pa'i gnas mtha' dag 'du zhing rdzogs pa yin phyir/ rigs kyi bu rnams/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i tshul khrims de dag bdag las len par 'dod dam/ zhes dri zhing*/ shin tu len par 'tshal lags/ zhes slob mas brjod do/ 132)༈ de nas 'jug sdom dngos 'bogs phyir go don sprad de/ de nas rigs kyi bu tshe dang ldan pa rnams ma yongs par dgongs 'tshal/ 'di ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad don dam par yod med rtag chad la sogs kyi dmigs mtshan gang yang ma grub par spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa cig yin yang*/ kun rdzob tu 'gag med kyi snang ba sna tshogs par shar zhing ji ltar snang yang don la mi gnas pa rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ de la ji bzhin bden pa gang yang med/ chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin na'ang*/ sems can kun gyis de ltar ma shes pas mi bden pa la 133)bden par bzung ba kun rdzob rdzun snang la a 'thas kyi zhen 'khrul 'ba' zhig goms pa ches pas 'khor ba mtha' med du gtan 'khyams su gnas pa'i drin can pha ma'i chogs 'di rnams gtan bde byang chub kyi go 'phang la 'god phyir dang*/ de ltar 'god pa'i nus pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan la ma mchis mod kyi/

sangs rgyas de thob par byed pa'i rgyu dang thabs ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed cing de'i bslab pa'i gnas thams cad la spyod dgos pas na/ khyed cag rnams dus 'di nas bzung ste ji drid byang chub kyi snying po ma thob kyi bar du byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnam pa gsum bla zhing bsrung ba dang*/ rgyal sras byang sems kyi spyod pa 134)la dus 'di na 'jug par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa gsal thob cig ces brjod la/ skabs 'dir slob dpon nyid kyi rgyud la smon 'jug gi nyams rtogs ji tsam yod pa gsal btab cing*/ de dang slob mar snang ba'i rtogs pa sgyu ma lta bu gnyis dbyer med du mnyam par gzhag pa'i ngang nas 'di skad brjod pas sdom pa byin par bya ste/ ༈ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i skal ba bzang po can rigs kyi bu tshe dang ldan pa khyed rnams/ bdag byang chub sems ming 'di zhes bgyi ba las/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir 'gyur ba gang yin pa dang*/ phyogs bcu dag na da lta byung dang bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnams kyis ji ltar slob par mdzad pa'i bslab pa'i 135)gzhi gang yin pa rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul gzhi dag thams cad bdag las thob par 'dod dam/ zhes dang*/ slob mas kyang*/ shin tu 'dod lags/ zhes dang*/ tshul bzhin du nod dam/ zhes pa'i lan du/ tshul bzhin du nod par bgyi lags so/ zhes slob mas khas blangs bar bya'o/ yang*/ gong bzhin du byang chub kyi sems gsal thob la yid bzhin du ma yengs shig ces brjod nas/ ces brjed nas/ ༈ rigs kyi bu rnams/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ zhes sogs nas/ thob par 'dod dam/ zhes sogs dang*/

136)tshul bzhin du nod par bgyi lags so/ zhes pa'i bar du lag gnyis pa dang*/ lan gsum pa'i brjod pa rdzogs pa'i tshe byang sdom yongs rdzogs thob par dpon slob gnyis kas nges shes bya'o/ de tshe bla mas me tog 'thor zhing*/ byang chub sems ni rin po che/ ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig skyes pa nyams pa med par yang*/ gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog ces smon lam yang bya'o/ ༈ mjug gi cho ga la yang lnga yod de/ mkhyen par gsol ba/ phan yon brjod pa/ gsang bar gdams par/ bslab bya bstan pa/ gtang rag 'bul ba dang lnga'i/ dang po mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ slob ma rnams thal sbyar tsog pur 'dug cing*/ slob dpon gyis shar nas bzung ste phyogs bcur rim pa bzhin phyag gsum bya ba dang*/ shar phyogs kyi zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thams cad la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes sogs 137) phyogs mtshams kun la 'gro zhing*/ steng 'og gnyis kyi phyag shar nub gnyis la bya ba yin la/ gal te gnas khang khyon dog cing slob ma'i tshogs mang ba lta bus de ltar ma bde na ni rten mchog kyi phyogs su 'tsham ba yang rung ste/ phyogs de dang der mos des bya zhing tshig tha dad brjod pas 'tshal bar bya'o/ de nas slar bdug spos mchog rung bzang ba dang bcas te/ slob dpon gyi snyim par me tog 'thog la thal sbyar sus btsugs kyi shar phyogs sam rten mchod kyi phyogs su bltas nas 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ ༈ deng 'dir/ byang chub sems dpa'am ming { slob ma'i ming brjod cing*/ slob ma mang na de dag gi gtso ba'i ming brjod/ }'di zhes bya ba las byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims par blang ba la lan 138)gsum gyi bar du legs par nos pa lags/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'dis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la bdag byang chub sems dpa'am ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dbang du gyur par/

'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur yang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jigs rten gyi khams mthas gtugs pa'i chos thams cad lkog tu gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo/ zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod pa'i mthar slob dpon gnyis kas phyag bya zhing*/ lus mongs la btsugs pa'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thabs la spyi bos gtugs par mos shing*/ langs pa'i dus su bdag dang sems can thams cad 'khor ba nas ldang ba'i bsam la thal mo spyi bor sbyar bar bya'o/ ༈ gnyis pa phan yon bstan pa ni/ dpo slob gnyis ka langs te bla gos phag pa gcig tu gzar bas 139)slob ma thal sbyar dang slob dpon chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas 'di ltar brjod do/ ༈ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod rnams nyon cig 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa'a'i sdom pa yag dag par len pa'i las brjod pa rdzogs pa'i de'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di lta bu'i ltas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sa g.yo bar 'gyur/ lha'i rnga'o che grags par 'gyur/ me tog gi 'char 'bab par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing ga { mi 'jed kyi zhing la sogs kyi ming*/ }ge mo zhig na byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di { slob dpon/ }zhes bya ba las byang chub sems dpa'am 'di { slob ma/ }dang 'di zhes bgyi ba dag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par nos 140) po zhes yang dag par mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag gi chos kyi brtse bas bu dang spun zlar dgongs par mdzad la/ de ltar dgongs par mdzad pas byang chub sems dpa' 'o skol rnams kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur ro/

zhes brjod nas dpon slob gnyis ka 'dug go gsum pa gsang bar gdams pa ni/ 'di'i dgos pa ni 'phags yul sogs su thog dman gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa ches mang ba'i theg chen blor mi shong zhing smod pa rnams la dgongs kyi/ bod yul mtha' 'khob kyi mi phal mo che ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i mthus theg chen la mos pa shas che yang*/ 'ga' zhig rang skal gyi skyon can srid pa na/ de'i phyir slob dpon gyi 'di ltar gdams te/ ༈ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba 141) khyed rnams nyon cig byang chayab sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blangs ba 'di dad pa med pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir dad pa med pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rab tu bstan na dad pa med pa'i sems can de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la ma dad pas spong bar byed de/ de yang ji snyed byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur pa de snyed kyi bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po dad pa de la ldan par gyur ro/ gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems can sdug bsngal las yongs su bsrung bar bya ba yin pas sdig pa las ldog par bya ste/ de'i phyir mchog tu dge ba'i byang chub kyi sems gsang bar 142)bya ba yin no/

zhes brjod do/ ༈ bzhi pa bslab bya bstan pa'i rim pa ni/ rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi lugs 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i sa nas gsungs pa bzhin bshad de/ ༈ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' khyed rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa legs par thob pa de ma nyams par bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir dgag pa'i bslab bya dang*/ yon tan gong du spel bar bya ba'i phyir sgrub pa'i bslab bya dang gnyis yod pa'i dang po la/ pham pa dang 'dra ba'i chos bzhi dang*/ nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi rnams spong dgos pa'i/ spang bya'i rtsa ba bzhi ni/ rnyed bkur 'dod nas rang gi yon tan brjod cing*/ gzhan la skur 'dibs byed pa dang*/ sdug bsngal zhing mgon med pa'i sems can skyobs par nus bzhin mi skyobs pa'am/ ser snas nor dang chos sogs 143) sbyin 'os mi sbyin pa dang*/ gzhan gyis nyes pa byas pa la 'gyod pas bshags kyang rang nyid mi nyan par khro zhing ko long byed pa dang*/ theg pa chen po spong zhing dam pa'i chos 'drar snang dang zog chos kyis gzhan bslu bar byed pa dang bzhi ste/ 'di dag nyon mongs kun dkris chen pos spyad na byang sdom rtsa ba nas 'jig par 'gyur la/ kun dkris 'bring dang chung ngus spyad na bshags bya'i nyes par 'gyur ba'o/ ༈ yan lag gi nyos byas bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'am rtsa drug tu bshad pa'i don dngos gzhi phal cher gong ma 'dir 'du yang rnam grangs tsam du byang pa las gsungs pa ni/ ji skad du/ dkon mchog gsum la gsum mi mchod/ 'dod pa'i sems kyi rjes su 144)'jug rgan pa rnams la gus mi byed/ dris pa la ni lan mi 'debs/ mgron bos bdag gir mi byed cing*/ gser la sogs pa lan mi byed/ chos 'dod pa la de mi byin/ tshul khrims 'chal rnams yal bar 'dor/ pha rol dad phyir slob mi byed/ sems can don la bya ba chung*/ snying brtser bcas na mi dge med/ 'tsho ba log pa dang du len/

'phyar zhing rab tu rgod pa sogs/ 'khor ba gcig pur bgrod pa sems/ grags pa ma yin mi spong ba/ nyon mongs bcas kyang 'chos mi byed/ gshe la lan du gshe ba sogs/ khros pa rnams ni yal par 'dor/ pha rol shad kyi chags pa spod/ khros pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug rnyed bkur 'dod phyir 'khor rnams sdud/ 145)le lo la sogs sel mi byed/ chags pas bre mo'i gtam la bsten/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don mi tshol/ bsam gtan sgrib pa spong mi byed/ bsam gtan ro la yon tan blta/ nyan thos thog pa spong bar byed/ rang tshul yod bzhin de la brtson/ brtson min phyi rol bstan bcos brtson/ brtson par byas kyang de la dga'/ theg pa chen po spong byed dang*/ bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod/ chos kyi don du 'gro mi byed/ dge la smod dang mi dger bsten/ dgos pa'i grogs su 'gro mi byed/ nad pa'irim 'gro bya ba spong*/ sdug bsngal sel bar mi byed dang*/ bag med la yang rigs mi ston/ byas la lan du phan mi 'dogs/ gzhan gyi mya 146) ngan sol mi byed/ 'khor rnams kyi no don mi byed/ gzhan gyi blo dang mthun mi 'jug yon tan bsngags pa sma mi byed/ rkyen dang 'tshal pa tshar mi gcod/ rdzu 'phrul bsdigs la sogs mi byed/ snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*/ sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ ces gsungs pa 'di dag ni so thar la dge slong gi nyes byas kyi sde tshan lta bu dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni byang chub sems dpa' nus pa can cung zad ldan zhing rgyud tshod mtho ba'i rigs la dgongs pa dag kyang yod la/ de ltar dgag pa'i bslab bya rnams kyi dri mas ma gos par bya'o/ ༈ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i bslab bya ni/ spyir pha rol du phyin pa drug la slob cing*/ khyad par du tshul khrims rnam pa gsum 147)la 'bad pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad kyi snying po yin te/ de yang mi dge ba bcu dang 'tsham med pa lnga la sogs pa rang bzhin gyi mi dge ba rnams dang*/

de'i steng du rang nyid so thar ris bdun gang la gnas pa de'i spang bya'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ 'di skabs smin 'jug gnyis kyi spang bya'i rnam grangs mtha' dag gi nyes pas ma gos pa ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ pha rol du phyin pa drug gi mi mthun phyogs dag ma 'dres shing mthun phyogs rnams la 'bad pa dang*/ chos spyod rnam pa bcu { yi ge 'bri/ mchod/ sbyin/ nyan/ klog 'dzin/ 'chad/ kha bton byed/ don sems/ sgom pa dang bcu'o/ }dang*/ tshogs gnyis la ngoms pa med par 'bad pa ni dge ba chos sdug kyi tshul khrims/ rang nyid kyi nus pa dang mthun 148)pa'i sems can gyi don la ngal ba dang zhum pa med par brtson pa ni sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnams pa gsum la dus dag nas bzung ste mthar thug byang chub kyi snying po ma thob kyi bar du yang dag par bzung zhing bsrung ba dang blang dor gyi gnas la rab tu brtson par bya zhing*/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pas ni rang gzhan gyi nye pa thams cad spong ba nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims la gtso bor nyams su len dgos te/ rang rgyud nyon mngos pa shas che ba'i dus yin pa'i phyor dang*/ mos spyod kyi skabs rnams su ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad bdag dang gzhan la sgrub pa'i dus yin pas dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul gtso bor nyams su blangs/ sa thob nas bzung ste rang rgyud kyi 149)skyon dag cing yon tan 'phel ba'i nus pas dngos dang brgyud nas sems can gyi don rang shugs kyis 'grub pa'i dus yin tshe sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gtso che bar spyod pa'i dus yin par gsungs shing*/ mdor bsdu na/ dus da nas bzung ste lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba'i rigs su gyur tshad ci nus kyi spong ba dang*/ rnam dkar dge ba'i rigs gyur phra zhing phra ba tshun chad ci nus ci lcogs kyi sgrubs pa dang*/

gang dang gang sgrub pa de thams cad 'jig rten chos brgyad dam nyan rang zhi bde'i bsam pa dang ma 'dres par mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rdzogs byang la god phyir gyi byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral ba nyid 'di'i nyams len gyi rtsa ba 150)dang yang snying yin pas lag len du thebs par byas na/ de ring phan chad nas khyed kyi rgyud la bsod nams kyi phung po nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rgyun chad med par 'phel ba lags te/ 'di lta ste/ dper na lcags kyi phung po ji tsam pa yang gser 'gyur gyi rtsi yis reg ma thag thams cad gser gyi dngos po 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur te de las nam yang 'gyur ba nyams pa dang ldog pa'i skabs mi srid pa lta bu ste/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i rtsi yis zin pa'i bya byed mtha' dag sangs rgyas kyi rgyu kho na las gzhan du srid pa ma yin te/ de ltar yang spyod 'jug las/ gang nas bzung ste sems can khams/ mtha' yas rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ mi ldog pa yi sems kyi ni/ sems de yang dag blangs 151)gyur pa/ deng nas bzung ste gnyid log gi bag med gyur kyang bsod nams phung*/ rgyun mi chad pa du ma zhig nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims dang ldan pa de khams gsum kun gyi bkur ba'i zhing mchog dam par gyur pa ste/ sred med kyi nus zhus pa'i mdo las/ tshul khrims kyi phung po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la lha rnams kyis rtag tu phyag byas pa yin/ klu rnams kyi rtag tu bsngags pa yin/ gnod sbyin rnams kyis rtag tu bstod pa yin/ dri za thams cad kyi rtag tu mchod pa yin/ bram ze dang rgyal rigs dang tshong dpon dang khyim bdag rnams kyis rtag tu gsol ba yin/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rtag tu dgongs pa yin/ 152)lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis rtag tu bskur ba yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol du phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pas 'tshang rgya ba yin no/

zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gnas skabs mngon par mtho ba dang mthar thug nges par legs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa 'di las 'byung bar shes pas byang chub kyi spyod pa la bslab par byos shig yang gal te byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rin po che de las nyams na so thar tsam nyams pa dang yang mi mtshungs te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis khrol zhing*/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can mtha' dag bslus par gyur pas/ bskal pa grangs med par ngan song ngu mnar bar 'gyur ba dang*/ byang chub kyi myu gu skem par 'gyur bas na/ ci nas kyang 153)ma nyams par 'bad dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ sems mchog de las nyams gyur na/ rgyal kun mi mnyes 'gro kun bslus/ rang gzhan don nyams ngan 'gror 'gro/ de bas 'bad de sems 'di bsrung zhes pa de lta bu'i spang blangs ma nor ba la brtson dgos pa lags/ ༈ lnga pa btang rag 'bul ba ni/ de ltar khyed kyi rgyud la bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon legs par bskrun te/ mi las lhar bsgyur/ rgyal bu rgyas par bkod/ dbul po la rin sbyin/ lcags gser du bsgyur ba lta bus/ kha sang phan chad so so skye bo la de ring tshun chad nas byang chub sems dpar krongs kyi gyur nas/ sgo gsum gyi mi dge ba thams cad zad par byas/ lung ma bstan gyi bya 154)ba rnams dge bar bsgyur/ dge ba thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi nye rgyud bsgrub nas sangs rgyas kyi lam la gol chugs med par btsud pa 'di ni dkon mchog dang bla ma'i bka' drin kho na yin pa shes par mdzod la/ sku srin gso phyir rang gi lus longs spyod gtan mdun mtha' dag 'bul ba'i mos pa dang ldan pas rjes zlos 'di bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ ༈ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ dus gusam dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ gus pas khyed la 'bul bar bgyi/ kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa/

yon gnas ngam pa khyed rnams kyis/ bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ bdag gi 'di bdag bzhes su gsol/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*/ byang chub spyod 155)la gzhol ba dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung ste/ bdud kyi las kyang spong bar shog bdag gi bsod nams ci bsags pa/ thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas/ ring por mi thegs 'gro ba kun/ byang chub nyid la 'god byed shog ces brjod de phyag bya zhing*/ slob dpon gyi kyang dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang mdo nas 'byung ba'i gag la ser sna ma sogs kyi brjod kyang rgyas par bya'o/ smon 'jug gnyis kyi sdom pa'i cho ga grub pa'o/ ༈ don dam byang chub sems bskyed pa'i tshul la/ spyir theg chen gyi chos thams cad bden gnyis dang thabs shes kyi sgrom nas thon dgos phyir sems bskyed kyi skabs 'dir yang kun rdzob don dam gyi byang sems zung du 'brel ba dang*/ sngags kyi skabs su de gnyis po rten dang brten pa zla ba rdo rje'i brda don gyi tshul sogs 'byung ba la chos lugs thams cad thun mod kyang*/ byang sdom gyi skabs 156) 'dir don dam sems bskyed cho gas thob mi thob kyi dgag sgrub mdzad srol byung mod kyi/ 'dir ni dgag sgrub kyi tshig tshogs smra ba'i skabs ma yin pa dang*/ don dam byang sems de nyid bsgom stobs kyi skye ba las/ chog gas 'bogs tu mi rung gi rtsod gzhi du ma snang ba rnams btang snyoms su bzhag cing*/ cho gar ming 'dogs gang ltar mdzad rung bsgom stobs kyi skye ru de nyid bla mas ngo sprad par bsgom ru gang yin shes par yang dka' zhing*/ sngags kyi dbang bzhi pa'i thabs gnad dang mtshungs phyir/ des na 'di skabs kyi gzhung spang skong phyag rgya'i mdo'i dgongs pa ji lta bar mgon po klu sgrub zhabs kyis sgrigs chags su mdzad pa bzhin brjod par bya zhing*/ 'di la sems skyed zhu ba'i gang zag bzhed lugs 'di la mos pa dang blor shong ba dag la 'bogs par bya'i/

lugs 'di la mi mos pa'i rigs la ni phogs kyang mi skye la/ slob dpon la yang snod dang mi mthun pa'i gdams pa bstan pa'i nyes ltung 'byung 157) bas na snod dang gnas skabs shes dgos pa nyid do/ de bas na 'di nyid kyi snod dang skal bar gyur pa dag la don dam byang chub sems bskyed pa'i thabs ni/ mchod pa bzang po gsar du bshams pa'i kha gso ba gang rigs dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la gus phyag dgu phrugs maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa phul la thal mo sbyar te gus pas 'khod pa la slob dpon gyi 'di ltar brjod de/ ༈ de ltar skal bzang khyed cag gi rgyud la kun rdzobs byang sems smon pa dang 'jug pa'i rim pa legs par bskrun pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi skal ba can du bsgrub nas/ da ni don mad pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che/ thams cad kyi mdo don/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po/ nges don thams cad kyi mthar thug 'di nyid ston par byed pa la/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang*/ rnam 158)pa lag tu blang ba gnyis kyi dang po ngo bo ni/ rang gi sems ye gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtshan mas dben zhing skye 'gag gnas gsum 'gro 'ong gi dngos po'am yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de la don dam byang chub kyi sems zhes bya la/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ces kyang bya ba dang*/ kun gzhi byang chub kyi sems su yang brjod pa ste/ gnas lugs don gyi ye shes 'dus ma byas pa'i rang nyid de/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ chos bdag med pas mnyam nyid pas/ rang sems gdod nas skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin yin 159)la/ 'o na de lta bu'i stong nyid yin na sems bskyed ma bskyed kyi tha snyad ji ltar ga ga snyam na/

sems de'i ngo bo la bskyed rgyu bskyed mkhan bskyed bya sogs kyi spros mtshan ma dmigs kyang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid ji lta bar rtogs pa cig med na/ dbul po'i khyim yagi gter dang gyad kyi dpral ba'i nor bu'i dpe bzhin te/ sems can thams cad la de nyid kyi ma khyab pa gang yang med par thog ma med nas rang la yod kyang rang ngo ma shes pas phan ma thogs/ don ma grub/ mngon du ma gyur pas 'khor ba mu mtha' med par 'khyams/ 'khrul/ mnar ma rig las nyon gyi shugs drag pos bskyod pa 'di bzhin lags mod kyi/ dus dang res dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 160)bka' drin gyis mtshams sbyar te/ rang la yod pa rang ngo ma sprad/ rgyal bu dmangs su 'khyams pa rgyas par bkod pa ltar byed pa la don dam byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ces bgyi ba lags/ ༈ de ltar ngo bo ngos bzung nas/ rnam pa lag tu blang ba la/ spang skong phyag rgya'i mdo'i dgongs pa bzhin mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i kun rdzob don dam zung 'jug gi sems bskyed la/ sbyor ba tshogs bsags cing don dam gyi skyabs su 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi sems bskyed tshig gis gsal gdab cing don gyis dam 'cha' ba/ rjes nyams len gyis lam du 'khyer zhing smon lam gyi rgyas gdabs pa dag bcas pa 'di dag gi tshig so so'i skabs dang mthun pa'i don yid la legs par bsam la 161)rjes zlos 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ ༈ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas thog ma dang mtha' ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/

lus dang ngag dag yid kyis/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang pha ma dang sems can gang dag la/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang dgyid du stsal ba dang bgyis pa la rjes su yi 162)rang ba ci mchis pa de dag thams gcag tu bsdus shing bsdoms te sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar bla na med pa'i so sor bshags pas so sor 'chags so/ mi 'chab bo/ slan chad 'di lta bu mi dgyid do/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bsod nams kyi rjes su yi rang ba bla na med pa thugs su chud pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rang 'phags pa nyan thos rnams dang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ ༈ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi chad par bya ba'i slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi 163)snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso la skyabs su mchi ste/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa thams cad dang bral ba skyes bu chen po skyes bu khyu mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sku bla na med pa'i sku chos kyi sku mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi'o/ chos 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ bla na med pa de bzhin gshegs pa la mnga' ba zhi ba chos kyi sku so so rang gis rig pa la skyabs su mchi ste/ bla na med pa de bzhin gshegs pa la mnga' ba zhi ba chos kyi sku so so rang gis rig pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ dge 'dun dul ba'i tshogs kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dge 'dun la

164)skyabs su mchi'o/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la gnas kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dus ji lta ba dang stobs ci mchis pa bzhin du bdag dbul zhing mchi na mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan dag gis bdag bzhes su gsol/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag sngon du byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad sgrol ba dang sems can thams cad 'grol ba dang sems can thams cad dbyugs dbyung ba dang sems can mya ngan las zlo ba dang sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god 165)pa'i slad du ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sems can thams cad sgrol ba dang sems can thams cad 'grol ba dang sems can thams cad dbyug dbyung ba sems can thams yongs su mya ngan las zlo ba dang sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god pa'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag gis/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam 166)pa nyid kyi rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs ba/ chos bdag med pa gnyis pa nyid kyi rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pu nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam par nyid 167)kyi rang gi sems gdod ma nas maskyes pa stong pa nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed par dgyi'o/

zhes pa 'di don de sems bskyed dngos de 'di nyid yin no/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis/ bdud dpung dang bcas pa mtha' dag pham par mdzad de nyid mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang bdud dpungs pa dag bcas pa pham par bgyis te bdag mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar dgyi'o/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis nyid mngon par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa de bzhin 168)du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang bdag nyi mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi'o/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra btsom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis nyid mngon par sangs rgyas nas tshogs yongs su bsdus pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ bdag mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgyas nas tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bgyi'o/ ༈ byang chub mchog tu sems ni bskyed par dgyi/ sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ongs spyad par dgyi/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog bdag gis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang*/ gzhan yang bdag gi 169)bsod nams cung zad bgyis pa dang dgyi bar 'gyur ba'i dge rtsa de dag thams cad pha ma la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ bdag gi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ bdag gi bsod nams 'dis pha ma la sogs pa'i sems can ma rgal ba rnams bdag gi bsgral lo/ ma grol ba rnams bdag gi 'grol lo/ dbugs ma phyin pa rnams bdag gi dbyugs dbyung ngo*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams ni yongs su mya ngan las zla'o/

mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas pa rnams mngon par 'tshang rgya bar bgyi'o/ skyabs ma mchis pa dang*/ gnas ma mchis pa dang dpung gnyen ma mchis pa'i 'jig rten gyi skyabs dang gnas dang dpung gnyen du gyur cig 170)deng nas bdag sbyin pa stsol ba dang tshul khrims bsrung ba dang bzod pa sgom pa dang brtson grus rtsom pa dang bsam gtan la mnyam par gzhag pa dag shes rab rnam par dpyod pa dang thabs mkhas pa la slob pa gang ci yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don dang phan pa dag bde ba'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la brtsams te/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang ldan pa theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa sa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa rnams kyi rjes su mthun par 'jug go/ ༈ 'phags pa/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' lags kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' lags par bzung du gsol/ ༈ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*/ rtsi dang nags kyi shing 171)lta bur/ rtag tu srog chags thams cad kyi/ 'dod dgu dpag med spyod par shog mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang*/ thos pa dang ni dran pas kyang*/ bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ nad rnams gso ba nyid gyur cig sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stong par shog byang chub sems dpa'i gang dag par bzhugs pa/ de dag kun gyi smon lam bdag 'grub shog ༈ de dag gis khyod kyi rgyud la don dam byang chub kyi sems gzod ma nas rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes pa de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drin dang dkon mchog rin po che'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs las legs par skyes shing rang ngo phrod pa de la chos nyid kyis thob pa ces pa'i tha snyad du grags kyang*/ rten 'brel tshogs 172)pa'i mthu las byung ba lags shing*/ da ni de nid nyams len gyis gong du 'phel zhing goms pa dang brtan pa thob par bya ba la/

da lta'i sems gang ltar shar ba'i rag ngo la tser gyi bltas la/ sngar 'das kyi rnam rtog gi rjes 'breng mi bya ma 'ongs pa'i rtog pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da lta'i sems la mtshan 'dzin bcos slad dgag sgrub gang yang mi bya bar sems kyi 'dug tshul yin gyi thog tu lhod kyi 'jog pa de la don dam byang chub kyi sems sgom pa zer ba lags/ de ltar bzo bcos med par rang ngo rang rang gis rig pa de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ye shes chos kyi sku nyid rang sems dang tha dad med par gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa de nyid ji lta bar rtogs pa yin te/ sngar kun rdzob byang sems kyis sangs rgyas 173)kyi rigs nges par byas shing*/ 'dir don dam byang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid du byas pa yin te/ yon tan rin po che bsdus pa'i mod las/ mkhas pa 'jig rten gnas pa'i mya ngan 'das kyang rung*/ chos nyid skyon med chos rnams stog pa 'dir gnas te/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gis chos 'di rjes su rtogs/ de phyir de bzhin gshegs ces sangs rgyas mtshan gsol te/ ces gsungs pas na/ ma rigs 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud kyi rjes 'brang mi bya bar don dam byang chub kyi sems gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i nyams len gyi ngang nas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can mtha' yas pa rnams la stong nyid kyi rtsal mdangs snying rjer shar ba'i kun rdzob byang sems smon 'jug gi phrin las rgyun 174)chad med pas byang chub kyi spyod pa yang dag par spyad pa la 'bad 'tshal/ ༈ rjes smon lam gyi rgyas gdab pa gong du song nas/ nyams len lam du 'khyer tshul ni bshad ma thag pa 'di nyid lags shing*/ ༈ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems gsum bskyed pa'i phan yon gyi rim pa ni chos mtha' dag pa'i gzhir gyur tshe de'i phan yon gyi mtha' dang tshad ni de bzhin gshegs pas kyang brjod par mi lang na so so skye bos lta ga la zhig ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas su gyur la/

'on kyang brda tsam mtshon byed tsam du 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i mdor/ rgyal ba ma pham 175)pas byang chub sems dpa' nor bzag la gsung pa kho na la mtshon na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi dkar po'i lo tog 'phel bas zhing lta bu/ 'jig rten thams cad brten pas sa lta bu/ dbul ba thams cad gcod pa rnam thos kyi bu lta bu/ don thams cad yang dag par sgrub pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pas bum pa bzang po lta bu/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yongs su bsrung bas pha lta bu/ don ma grub pa phyir mi ldog pa khyab 'jug gi mdung lta bu/ nyon mongs pa'i mgo ltung bar byed pas ral gri lta bu/ 'khor ba'i chu be na gnas pa rnams 176)steng du 'byin pa mchil { nya 'dzin pa'i lcogs kyu/ }pa lta bu/ sgrib pa dag khebs pa'i rtsa ba thams cad rnam par 'byin pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor lta bu/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyis las sar par byed pa tho rengs kyi rnga lta bu/ chos thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan dga' bar byed pas dbyig { nor bu/ }lta bu/ chos kyi dga' ba dang mos pa nyams su myong bar byed pa bza' shing gi ra ba lta bu/ rang gi ngo bo la nyes pa thams cad dang bral bas gser lta bu rmongs pa'i nad thams cad sel ba sman lta bu/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid tshim par byed pa glu dbyangs snyan po lta bu dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan zil gyis gnon pa rdo rje nor bu rin po che lta bu/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang bcas 177)pa'i 'jig rten na mchod pa lta bu'o/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang smon lam thams cad bsdus pas mdor bstan pa lta bu'o/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi sems kyi yon tan de dag dang*/ yon tan gyi bye brag tshad med pa gzhan dang yang ldan no/ zhes sogs che ba'i yon tan gyi dpe nyis brgya lhag par gsungs pa rnams skabs 'dir smin na ha cang tshig tshogs ches par 'gyur phyir ma brjod kyang don gyi 'gags 'di dag tu 'du zhing go bar 'gyur mod kyi/

mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug gi legs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas dam pa/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi gzhi dang lam dang thabs dang nye rgyu'i snying por gyur pa sems 178)gsum rin po che'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don nam mkha' mnyam par mdzad pa'i go cha dang mi 'bral ba'i ngang nas bla ma dang dkon mchog la sku drin gso ba'i maṇ+ḍal dang*/ byang chub kyi sems ma nyams shing mi brjed pa'i smon lam bzang po dzag bcas pas phyag ci mang mdzad par zhu/ zhes brjod cing*/ slob ma rnams kyi kyang de bzhin ci nus dang*/ bla mas kyang shis brjod dang*/ dkon mchog gi drung du gtang rag gi mchod pa sogs kyang bya'o/ de ltar theg gi shing rta'i srol rnam pa gnyis las byung ba'i byang sdol cho ga'i las rim rgyas bsdus sna tshogs shing mtha' yas pa cig grub mtha' chos rgyud so so'i yig cha las 'byung mod kyi/ de dag rang rang gi dgongs bzhed mthun pa dang mi mthun pa ltar snang ba'i tshul du ma ni/ ji ltar nya ra bu ram sbrang rtsi 'o ma sogs kyi mngar ba'i re gcig bu'i 179) bye brag la gang zag so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun par spyod pas tshem mod kyi/ 'di ni mngar ba yin la 'di ni ma yin no zhes bsnyen pa'i dgos pa ci zhig mchis pa de bzhin du/ dam pa'i chos thog tha bar du dge ba'i rang bzhin 'ba' zhig la/ bdag cag gi lugs 'di yin gyi khyed cag gi lugs de ma yin no zhes brgal zhing brtsad pas ni byang chub kyi sems 'bayong bar nam yang mi 'gyur bas na rtsod pa med pa'i bka' bstan bcos las ji ltar byung ba bzhin bdag gi 'dir bris kyis/ bdag 'dra blon pos rang bzor bgyis pa 'ga' yang ma mchis so/ 'on na bka' bstan bcos rnams la bzhugs bzhin du khyid kyi 'dir yang skyar du bris pas ci zhig bya zhe na/ de lta mod kyi 'di ni gang can sgrub rgyud mtha' dag gi 'byung khungs shān+ti dpal gyi ri bor chos kyis mthong ba'i seng ge'i khri la zhabs pad mngon par brjed chags pa'i

180) mnyam med mchog gi sprul pa'i sku thub bstan rin chen bzang po'i dpal phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas bka' mchod mu tig gi chun bu yang dag par stsal ba nyid bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bgyis nas/ thos bsam gyi sbyang stobs dang mi ldan yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che la nyams len gyi mthil phur du bgyis pa'i ku pā li rang grol gyi ming 'dzin pas/ chu rlung rta mchog kha 'bab g.yas su dung ltar 'khyil ba'i ngogs/ ri bran seng gi rnam par 'gyings 'dra'i spo la kun snang dang ba'i bsam gtan gyi khang bu brtsegs pa'i yang dben du bris pa'i dge ba lhag bsam mchog tu dkar ba'i 'od mdangs kyis/ khams gsum gyi 'gro ba drin can pha ma'i rang bzhin 'ba' zhig sa las nyon 'khrul pa'i mun gling mtha' med par bzod dka'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs rab tu myongs ba snying rje'i yul gyur rnams thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen 181) pa'i go 'phang la myur du 'khor rgyu rkyen du gyur nas/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad phyir mi ldog pa/ rab tu phan pa/ mchog tu bde ba/ 'gyur ba med pa'i gtan srid bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god par shog cig shu gh+ma sdu sarba dza ga tāṃ/ 182)
